evidence.discovery_title: Apple Planning to Launch Products Faster and More Often
evidence.raw_lead: Apple CEO John Ternus is undertaking efforts to restructure the company to accelerate product development and introduce new products more frequently, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Ternus apparently wants Apple to "broaden its range of devices and create a leaner organization with a greater focus on engineering".
evidence.title: Apple Planning to Launch Products Faster and More Often

units.text: Apple Planning to Launch Products Faster and More Often
Apple CEO John Ternus is undertaking efforts to restructure the company to accelerate product development and introduce new products more frequently, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

Ternus apparently wants Apple to "broaden its range of devices and create a leaner organization with a greater focus on engineering." One proposal under consideration is to rely less on Apple's traditional spring and fall product release cycles, and introduce new devices more quickly and throughout the year. Ternus has also purportedly indicated that Apple must become "more experimental" to remain competitive in the era of artificial intelligence.

Other plans include eliminating some middle-management positions to reduce corporate hierarchy that separates engineers from senior executives. Ternus believes "Apple should hire fewer people, ask more of its existing engineers, and reduce organizational bloat." During a presentation, he reportedly showed a slide detailing annual headcount growth and argued that the "company should be accomplishing more with fewer employees."

Ternus is also seeking new ways to generate more revenue from existing products amid slowing growth in the company's services business. The launch of new services has also been discussed. To cut costs, early planning meetings for 2027 have seen reductions in planned budget increases, flat staffing levels, and reduced marketing spending.

Gurman cautioned that the changes to Apple's long-standing practices will be challenging and could take years to achieve. There are already indications of changes taking place, with dismissals of directors and engineering program managers taking place in the past two weeks.

Those employees were given just weeks to find other positions within the company, and those who do not will be laid off. Other recent cutbacks have focused on the teams responsible for Siri, Vision Pro, AI-related software engineering, and Fitness+. Some employees believe that further layoffs are possible later this year and early next year.

Managers within Apple told Gurman that there is a sense of pressure to move faster, with more "hectic" and demanding "hands-on" work. Product development groups are "being pushed to deliver more products, more frequently and on shorter timelines."

evidence.discovery_title: 10 年来可维修性首破 0 分：iFixit 拆解苹果 AirPods 5，耳机电池可更换
evidence.raw_lead: 国外维修团队 iFixit 今天（9 月 30 日）发布视频，分享了苹果 AirPods 5 的拆解报告，最终可维修得分为 2 分（满分 10 分，分数越高代表越容易维修），也成为过去 10 年来首次突破 0 分的 AirPods。
evidence.title: 10 年来可维修性首破 0 分：iFixit 拆解苹果 AirPods 5，耳机电池可更换

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，国外维修团队 iFixit 今天（9 月 30 日）发布视频，分享了苹果 AirPods 5 的拆解报告，最终可维修得分为 2 分（满分 10 分，分数越高代表越容易维修），也成为过去 10 年来首次突破 0 分的 AirPods。
IT之家援引科技媒体 9to5Mac 报道，自从 2016 年初代 AirPods 问世以来，iFixit 团队对其产品的维修评分始终为 0/10，而 AirPods 5 打破该限制，成为十年来首款得分非零的 AirPods。
iFixit 团队在拆解后指出，之所以给出 2 分评价，主要在于可以移除和更换 AirPods 的电池，且整个更换过程不会损坏整机。不过左右耳机的电池极性相反、触点位置略有差异，导致不可互换。
图源：视频截图
iFixit 强调给 AirPods 更换电池依然需要较高的技术要求，仅适合技术娴熟的专业人员或极具冒险精神的 DIY 用户。
若尝试对耳机进行更深入维修，仍无法避免破坏性拆解。充电盒同样难以无损打开与重组，整体维修门槛依旧极高。
拆解视频包含 CT 扫描图像，清晰呈现耳塞内部高度集成的布局。电池、MEMS 麦克风、H2 芯片等微小组件被紧密排布于狭小空间内。

evidence.discovery_title: Apple’s new CEO could change when it launches phones and laptops
evidence.raw_lead: John Ternus is already putting his stamp on the company.
evidence.title: Apple’s new CEO could change when it launches phones and laptops

units.text: John Ternus, Apple’s new CEO, wants Apple to launch products more often than its usual splashy moments in the fall and the spring, according to a Bloomberg report detailing some of Ternus’s initial plans for the company.

Apple regularly holds iPhone launch events in September and often announces products later in the year and in springtime, but “Ternus has indicated that Apple must introduce products more quickly and become more experimental to remain competitive in the artificial intelligence era,” Bloomberg says. The shift may not happen right away given Apple’s “long-established” development practices. Apple is rumored to have a considerable number of products in the pipeline, including a new HomePod Mini, iPad Mini, and Apple TV 4K, AirPods with cameras, touchscreen MacBooks, and a special 20th anniversary iPhone.

Ternus is also considering reducing layers between engineers and senior executives, and the hardware engineering team dismissed “a number” of engineering program managers in the past two weeks, Bloomberg says. Those cuts follow recent layoffs on its Siri and Vision Pro teams that Bloomberg reported on in August. Apple also apparently considered laying off 5,000 AppleCare customer service staffers, but “ultimately put those plans on hold.”

evidence.discovery_title: 苹果 iOS 27.0.1 未修复：部分用户反馈新操作可导致 iPhone 18 Pro / Max 崩溃
evidence.raw_lead: 在 iOS 27.0.1 更新修复“同时打开通知中心和控制中心可能会导致触摸屏无响应”问题后，TechDroider 等海外科技指出，在 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，还存在另一个显示故障。
evidence.title: 苹果 iOS 27.0.1 未修复：部分用户反馈新操作可导致 iPhone 18 Pro / Max 崩溃

units.text: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，在 iOS 27.0.1 更新修复“同时打开通知中心和控制中心可能会导致触摸屏无响应”问题后，TechDroider 等海外科技指出，在 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，还存在另一个显示故障。
根据用户反馈的复现操作，在 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 主页面上长按 App 图标进入编辑状态，用一根手指拖动主屏幕上的某个小组件（widget），然后点击页面指示器（Page Control，即屏幕底部表示当前是第几屏的小圆点），再次进入某个页面后就会触发问题。
影响范围上，目前问题聚焦在 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上。此外根据用户反馈升级到 iOS 27 的 iPhone 17 系列手机执行上述操作，并未复现上述问题。
有网友在苹果美国第五大道的 Apple Store 线下体验区上测试，确认已成功复现该问题。IT之家查询 X 平台，也有多名用户反馈成功复现。

evidence.title: Counterpoint预测iPhone Duo年销量600万部！苹果一举拿下全球折叠屏25%份额

units.text: 快科技9月30日消息，Counterpoint Research首次对苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo销量作出预测，预计苹果今年将售出约600万部iPhone Duo。
Counterpoint高级分析师林科宇表示，600万部这个数字更符合折叠屏手机的小众市场销量规模，与苹果常规iPhone系列的年销量相去甚远。
不过，最终销量将取决于苹果新硬件的产能爬坡进度。
iPhone Duo定价1999美元，定于10月发售，位于苹果产品线顶端，承载着整个折叠屏行业提振消费兴趣和销量的期望。
若按600万部计算，苹果有望在上市首年即占据全球折叠屏市场近25%的份额。
目前三星在全球折叠屏市场份额约为40%，位居第一，苹果首年即可直追至第二。
IDC预计，折叠屏手机在2026年全球智能手机总销量中占比不到3%，明年整体比例也不会有明显变化。
iPhone Duo采用内折设计，展开为7.6英寸内屏，闭合时为5.4英寸外屏，内外屏显示比例保持一致，配备双eSIM，不支持实体SIM卡。
分析认为，iPhone Duo的初始需求更多来自苹果忠实用户，对折叠屏市场的长期拉动作用仍有待观察。

evidence.discovery_title: 苹果向 AirPods 5 等耳机推送 Beta 固件 9B5042a
evidence.raw_lead: 苹果公司今天（9 月 30 日）面向开发者与公开测试用户，推送适用于 AirPods Pro 3 等 5 款耳机产品的 Beta 固件，版本号为 9B5042a。
evidence.title: 苹果向 AirPods 5 等耳机推送 Beta 固件 9B5042a

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，苹果公司今天（9 月 30 日）面向开发者与公开测试用户，推送适用于 AirPods Pro 3 等 5 款耳机产品的 Beta 固件，版本号为 9B5042a。
在适配机型方面，IT之家查询公开资料，本次固件更新适用于以下耳机：
AirPods Pro 2
AirPods Pro 3
AirPods 4
AirPods 5
AirPods Max 2
更新内容方面，苹果公司惯例没有公布此次固件具体改动，按照以往情况，预估改进稳定性、电池管理、降噪可靠性、自动设备切换、通话质量等。
在更新操作方面，用户需将 AirPods 连接至运行 iOS 26、iPadOS 26 或 macOS 26 及以上版本的 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac。在 AirPods 设置界面中，可找到“Beta 固件”选项并手动开启。
启用 Beta 更新后，固件将通过后台自动下载，耳机需连接 Apple 设备并接通电源升级。

evidence.raw_lead: 苹果公司今天（9 月 30 日）发布博文，联合美国儿科学会发布《构建健康习惯：家庭指南》，在 iOS 27 系统内置家长控制工具中融入权威儿科建议。
evidence.title: 苹果 iOS 27 整合数字健康指南：6 步法帮家长科学管理孩子使用 iPhone 18 Pro 等

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，苹果公司今天（9 月 30 日）发布博文，联合美国儿科学会发布《构建健康习惯：家庭指南》，在 iOS 27 系统内置家长控制工具中融入权威儿科建议。
苹果在官方博文中表示，希望通过“家庭媒体计划”，帮助家庭成员共同探讨并培养健康的数字习惯，从而在屏幕时间与睡眠、运动、课业以及亲友相处时间之间取得平衡。
在操作框架上，该《指南》提出 6 个步骤：
开始讨论屏幕时间话题，并给父母一些提示，帮助他们正确进行沟通，设定合理的期望，让孩子感觉自己是制定计划的参与者。
创建儿童账户，以启用基于年龄的保护措施，并让家长能通过家长控制功能来管理孩子的数字体验。
调整网站和 app 安全设置，包括“购买前询问”和“请求浏览”，以便家长和孩子共同审核新的 app 和网站。
安排设备使用时间。借助“时间额度”和“日程”功能，平衡上网、睡眠、课业、体育活动，以及与亲友共度的时间。
管理通信内容。家长可以决定孩子能与谁沟通，同时所有 18 岁以下用户的通信安全功能都会默认开启，以帮助防止孩子观看或分享敏感内容。
随着孩子的成长延续对话，并提供调整家庭计划的长期指导。
以上图源：苹果官网
在年龄分层方面，美国儿科学会额外提供按年龄段细化的屏幕时间建议，覆盖婴儿、幼儿、学龄儿童及青少年。家长可依据孩子发育阶段，选择匹配的媒体使用策略与限制强度。
推送方面，新功能随 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27 等系统更新推送，需全家人的设备均升级至对应版本方可启用完整功能，让孩子科学合理使用 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、iPad Pro、MacBook Air、MacBook Pro 等产品。
IT之家援引博文介绍，附上 Apple 负责健康与健身业务的副总裁 Sumbul Desai 医学博士内容如下：
每个家庭都会按各自的方式使用科技产品。
因此，我们希望将美国儿科学会的可靠指南融入我们产品中内置的工具。两者结合，旨在适应每个家庭和每个孩子的不同成长阶段，为家长提供实用的出发点，以便他们选择最适合自己家庭的监管方式。
我们希望这份指南能推动更轻松的亲子对话，为家庭提供所需资源，将这份指南付诸实践，并随着孩子的成长调整方法，帮助他们培养能够融入日常生活的健康数字习惯。

Galaxy SmartTag3 首次支持跨系统兼容，除 Galaxy 设备外，也可与 iOS 设备配合使用。通过 SmartThings Find，用户可在支持设备上查看和分享标签位置，并使用附近搜索功能。

另外，SmartTag3 新增地点通知功能，用户可设定监控区域，当其移入或移出该范围时即可收到提醒；位置历史可保存最多 7 天，移动检测提醒可在标签移动时通知用户。
该产品支持 IP67 防尘防水，支持 NFC 丢失模式，扫描标签可显示注册联系信息；还支持位置数据加密、SmartThings 物联网控制、遗留提醒等功能。。

units.text: A recent report from Chinese outlet Jiemian News offers an update on iPhone Duo production, including how many units are being made, assembly troubles, and more.
Latest iPhone Duo report covers production struggles, target inventory, and more
iPhone Duo goes up for pre-order on October 16, just a little more than two weeks from now. And a recent report from Jiemian News provides the latest update on Apple’s production status.
We’ve seen reporting before that Apple’s foldable is having a slow ramp-up due to a complex assembly process.
Right now, iPhone Duo assembly yield is reportedly just over 60%. And per Jiemian, suppliers believe it could take another six months or more for production yields to reach a “mature” level.
That’s far below what would be expected for other models, but perhaps not surprising considering the Duo is packed with all-new product designs and components.
Per the report, Apple is targeting having 6-8 million iPhone Duo units ready to go for 2026. This compares to 20-30 million typical units for a flagship new Pro or Pro Max model.
View all comments

With a starting price of $1,999 and unique form factor, iPhone Duo isn’t targeting as broad a set of users as models like iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. The overall foldable market is still fairly niche, too.

If Apple sells anywhere near 8 million units before the end of 2026, that will no doubt be seen as a major win. But the iPhone Duo’s success will ultimately come down more to popularity over time. Will it be an early adopter model only, or prove a mass-market hit too?

A source told Jiemian that Apple so far has been unwilling to relax its strict quality standards for the iPhone Duo, thus leading to lower than expected yields. While that potentially will lead to shortages when the new model launches, I suspect anyone spending $2,000+ on an iPhone will want the highest quality product, so it’s not exactly bad news.
Are you planning to buy an iPhone Duo? Why or why not? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.raw_lead: 苹果专业视频拍摄应用 Final Cut Camera 推出 2.4 版本更新，新增支持 iPhone 18 Pro 可变光圈，带来全新设计与多项专业功能升级。
evidence.title: 苹果发布 Final Cut Camera 2.4：首次支持 iPhone 18 Pro / Max 可变光圈

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，iPhone 专业视频拍摄 App Final Cut Camera 迎来 2.4 版本重大更新，新增支持 iPhone 18 Pro 可变光圈，并随 iOS 27 为创作者带来更多专业选项。新版本今日（9 月 30 日）起以免费软件更新形式推出。
设计方面，Final Cut Camera 新版让创作者可以更轻松地调用快门开角、 ISO 和白平衡等常用设置；同时提供可自定义的叠层显示，包括用于精准掌控曝光的伪色和过曝提示，以及支持灵敏度调节的升级版对焦峰值。全新的 Tally 录制指示灯可清晰指示录制状态；用户还可通过双指轻点以清空取景器，从而专注于拍摄画面。
借助 iPhone 18 Pro，用户能够充分发挥配备可变光圈的全新融合式主摄的优势，这也是 Apple 迄今最先进的摄像头，首次为 iPhone 带来光圈控制功能。
Final Cut Camera 让创作者能够精准调节光圈设置，可灵活选择快门优先与光圈优先模式。此次更新还为常规视频解锁了电影效果模式特效，包括以 ProRes 和 Apple Log 格式拍摄的素材。创作者在使用 Final Cut Pro 剪辑视频时可直接调整焦点与景深。
配合 iOS 27，Final Cut Camera 新增支持专业视频示波器、纯净 SDI 输出以及 Genlock 偏置校准。创作者现可使用直方图与 RGB 分量图精准监看视频，后者通过显示红、绿、蓝三色通道，帮助检查色彩平衡与曝光情况。
此外通过纯净 SDI 输出，创作者可使用 HDMI 转 SDI 转换器发送干净的视频信号，实现广播级流媒体传输。借助 Genlock 偏置校准，创作者可消除拍摄屏幕画面时产生的画面伪影，或弥合 iPhone 与其他已同步锁相的摄像机之间的延迟差异。
IT之家附上官方更新日志内容如下：
探索精美的全新设计，包含可轻松访问的设置、可自定义的叠层、双指轻点在取景器中放置焦点功能、表示正在录制的状态指示灯等
使用配备 F1.48 至 F4 可变光圈的 48MP 融合式主相机拍摄惊艳视频，支持光圈优先、快门优先和手动模式
通过 RGB 列示图和直方图监视视频 **
通过假彩色和包含阈值设置的裁剪指示器调整曝光
使用改进后包含灵敏度控制的峰值对焦进行精准对焦

evidence.title: Apple Shares New Guide for Using iOS 27 Parental Controls

units.text: Apple Shares New Guide for Using iOS 27 Parental Controls

Apple today shared a guide meant to help parents use the child safety tools in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate. Apple says "Building Healthy Digital Habits: A Guide for Families" was developed in partnership with the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP).

The six-step guide covers balancing screen time with sleep, exercise, schoolwork, and time with friends and family. It has advice on getting kids on board with screen time limits and using the different parental control features. From Apple's announcement:
Start a conversation about screen time, with tips for parents to approach the topic and establish expectations in a way that helps kids feel included in the plan.
Create a Child Account, which enables age-based safeguards and gives parents access to parental controls to manage their child's experience.
Set safety settings for websites and apps, including Ask to Buy and Ask to Browse, so families can review new apps and websites together.
Make a schedule for device use, using Time Allowances and Schedules to balance time online with sleep, schoolwork, physical activity, and time with family and friends.

Manage communications, with parents deciding who their child can communicate with and Communication Safety, on by default for all users under 18, helping protect kids from viewing or sharing sensitive content.
Continue the conversation as kids grow, with guidance on adjusting the family's plan over time.
The guide includes the AAP's recommendations on screen time by age group, from infants to teens, along with strategies to help children develop healthy screen time habits.

Apple added new parental control options and an overhauled version of Screen Time in ‌iOS 27‌. Parents can choose which apps children can access, monitor and control website access, keep tabs on approved contacts, and set different screen time schedules based on time of day. Using the new version of Screen Time requires all devices in a Family Sharing group to be running ‌iOS 27‌, ‌iPadOS 27‌, macOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27.
The guide comes as Apple deals with regulatory pressure over child safety in countries like the UK, U.S., and Australia.

evidence.discovery_title: 苹果解释App Store移除ICEBlock等追踪应用的原因 称担忧执法人员安全 - Apple App Store/音乐/TV/新闻/播客 - cnBeta.COM
evidence.raw_lead: 苹果在今年7月致美国马里兰州民主党众议员杰米·拉斯金的一封信中，解释去年将ICEBlock及类似应用从AppStore下架的原因。此类应用允许用户汇报并共享美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）人员的实时位置。
evidence.title: 苹果解释App Store移除ICEBlock等追踪应用的原因 称担忧执法人员安全 - Apple App Store/音乐/TV/新闻/播客 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 苹果在今年7月致美国马里兰州民主党众议员杰米·拉斯金的一封信中，解释去年将ICEBlock及类似应用从App Store下架的原因。此类应用允许用户汇报并共享美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）人员的实时位置。
苹果表示，下架决定源于对执法人员安全的担忧，其中包括特朗普政府方面提出的关切；此前，达拉斯一处ICE办事处发生致命枪击，造成两名被拘留者死亡。
苹果于2025年10月将ICEBlock从App Store移除。拉斯金随后就美国司法部可能参与苹果App Store及GooglePlay商店下架相关应用一事展开调查。苹果这封回应信此前未被公开报道。
苹果当时通知ICEBlock开发者，执法部门提供的信息显示，该应用违反App Store审核指南1.1.1。苹果称，应用的用途是提供执法人员的位置资讯，而这些信息可能被用来伤害个别执法人员或整个群体，因此决定将其下架。ICEBlock至今尚未重新上架。

units.text: Apple has new beta firmware rolling out now for AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Pro 2, and select other models. Here are the details.
Apple releases new AirPods beta firmware for select models
If your AirPods have an H2 chip, there’s new beta firmware rolling out now for early testing.
Apple’s latest AirPods beta firmware has build number 9B5042a.
For reference, the current public version of AirPods firmware across AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Max 2, and more is 9A348. And the just-launched AirPods 5 use 9A350.
The new firmware is now available for AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Pro 2, AirPods 5, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

It’s unknown what changes the latest firmware introduces. Apple might be laying the groundwork for new features coming in iOS 27.1 or 27.2. Or the update might focus primarily on bug fixes and performance improvements.
If you’re interested in testing out the AirPods firmware before it launches to all users, you can opt into beta updates from the AirPods settings screen on your iPhone.
There’s no way to manually trigger a firmware update, but Apple has instructions here for ensuring the automatic update happens quickly.
Make sure that your iPhone, iPad, or Mac is updated to the latest version of iOS, iPadOS, or macOS, and that Bluetooth is on.
Make sure that your AirPods are connected via Bluetooth to your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Connect your iPhone, iPad, or Mac to Wi-Fi.
Connect your charging case to power.
Put your AirPods in their charging case and close the lid. Keep the lid of the charging case closed, and keep your AirPods in Bluetooth range of your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Wait at least 30 minutes for the firmware to update.
Open the lid of the charging case to reconnect your AirPods to your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Check the firmware version again.
Have you installed the new AirPods beta firmware? Let us know of anything new you find via the comments.

evidence.raw_lead: Apple TV recently recorded its biggest week ever for viewership, fueled by its Emmy wins and recent releases such as Ted Lasso and Mayday.
evidence.title: Emmy wins and recent premieres help Apple TV break records - 9to5Mac

units.text: Deadline reports that Apple TV recently recorded its biggest week ever for viewership, fueled by its 29 Emmy wins and recent releases such as Ted Lasso and Mayday. Here are the details.
Apple TV sees record viewership following the Emmys
A few weeks ago, Apple TV broke its own record with a total of 29 Emmy wins, 14 of which went to surprise hit Widow’s Bay.

Around the same time, Apple TV subscribers also got the return of Slow Horses, alongside recent releases including the Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh-led Mayday and the much-anticipated fourth season of Ted Lasso.
According to Deadline, this perfect storm helped Apple TV record its “highest weekly viewership ever for the week of Sept. 14, rising by +67% year-over-year.”
From Deadline:

Released straight-to-streaming on Sept. 4, Mayday has become Apple TV’s biggest film debut on the platform to date over its first 18 days, the company said. In the U.S., Mayday opened at No. 1 in Luminate’s Sept. 4-10 weekly rankings with 8.7M views. It remained strong in Week 2, placing at No.2.

The site also notes that, according to Apple TV, Widow’s Bay saw a whopping 280% week-over-week increase in viewership during the week after the Emmys, where it took home 14 awards, including Outstanding Comedy Series.
Apple TV noted that the increase was particularly notable in “the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Brazil, Mexico, Germany, India, Poland, and Spain,” says Deadline.

The company added that Pluribus saw a similar effect following its six Emmy wins, including Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series for Rhea Seehorn. The series “experienced a 200% surge in viewership week-over-week following the ceremony,” according to Apple.
Finally, Deadline notes that while the Emmys and recent premieres certainly helped drive the gains, Apple’s recent iCloud+ expansion may also have played a role.

Earlier this month, Apple began including Apple TV with iCloud+ at no extra charge in more than 100 countries, a rollout that also brought the streaming service to 59 new markets for the first time, expanding its total reach to 170 countries.
To read Deadline’s full report, which also includes data from Nielsen and Luminate, follow this link.
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month or as part of the Apple One bundle. It features hit TV shows and movies like Ted Lasso, Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.

Earlier this month, Apple began including Apple TV with iCloud+ at no extra charge in more than 100 countries, a rollout that also brought the streaming service to 59 new markets for the first time, expanding its total reach to 170 countries.

units.text: Today alongside a big update to Final Cut Camera, Apple announced that it’s rolling out updated versions of Pages, Keynote, Numbers, Pixelmator Pro, and Freeform. Here’s what’s new.
Apple rolling out updates to ‘Creator Studio’ apps, but non-subscribers get new features too
Apple has announced new features coming to its popular iWork suite today—Pages, Keynote, and Numbers—alongside improvements for Pixelmator Pro and Freeform.
Some additions are exclusive to Apple Creator Studio, but select features will be available for all users. Here’s everything new, per Apple Newsroom:
Pages, Keynote, Numbers

Apple says that today’s updates bring support for asking Siri questions about Pages, Keynote, or Numbers and get answers. It’s unclear if Siri AI is required or not, but that’s likely. The updates also enable “the ability to request access to a shared presentation, document, or spreadsheet.” This makes collaboration easier, as the file owner no longer needs to initiate file sharing.

Pages for Mac has a new Screen View, which “optimizes content for reading and focused writing.” And Numbers gets “new trigonometry, statistics, and logic functions for solving complex problems in a spreadsheet.”

Additionally, for Apple Creator Studio subscribers there are new templates and themes available across all three iWork apps. And in Keynote, intelligent slide generation will automatically make images that are tailored to a given presentation.
Pixelmator Pro

Pixelmator Pro on iPad adds Select and Mask tools that were previously Mac-exclusive. And both Mac and iPad apps gain two template collections for sports and action-centric projects, plus new templates for “launching a new creative idea, business, or product.”
View all comments
Additionally, there’s a new Podcasts category for creating cover artwork that’s sized to fit well on major podcast platforms.
Freeform

Freeform gains several highly requested features. Boards now automatically adapt to Dark Mode, and folders let users organize boards into collections and invite others to collaborate. Writing Tools with Apple Intelligence can rewrite, proofread, and summarize handwritten notes; users can also request access to collaborate on shared files, or automate adding content using Shortcuts. Freeform becomes even more powerful in visionOS 27, letting users pull multiple items from a board — including images, videos, sticky notes, shapes, and 3D models — into their space, and view 3D models together as a group.
What new features in today’s app updates stand out most to you? Let us know in the comments.
*Buy Mac with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple's long-rumored smart home hub will have an iMac G4-style design and a host of unique features, Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman reports. The smart home hub is said to feature a square 6-inch display, with variants that can be placed on a countertop or mounted on a wall. It features a single FaceTime camera on the front, with microphones and speakers in its connected base. Gurman described the design as follows: The hub is about as thick as an iPhone, and its display is surrounded by a quarter-inch, black bezel reminiscent of older iPads. It has rounded corners and no sharp edges. The device lacks a battery, so it has to be plugged in at all times, and there are no volume or power buttons. The product comes in Apple's standard gray aluminum finish and includes a USB-C port for power. The screen sits above a metal, round base with multiple rings of perforated speaker holes and connects to it through a polished metal arm. Users can manually tilt the display forward or backward. And the base has a rubberized bottom to help it stay on a table. The standard version looks reminiscent of the famous iMac G4 from 2002 that has a large display that sits on a half-dome-shaped base. Apple has also developed a second version, code-named J491, designed to be mounted on a wall. It has a thin, square-shaped base beneath the display that houses the speakers and microphones. The base sits flat on the wall below the screen. This version also must remain connected to power through a USB-C cable. Apple envisions customers placing several of the devices throughout their homes. Users will be able to control smart home devices, make video calls and intercom-style messages, play audio, and view slideshows of photos. The device will also be able to serve as an information hub for the kitchen, with the ability to watch videos and look up recipes with voice commands. It will also be able to recognize who is speaking to it or approaching it, and display personalized content and answers accordingly. The interface will change automatically depending on who is using the device, and there will be a mode for visitors that hides personal information. The smart home hub will identify users by their voice or facial recognition, but the latter system is said to be less reliable than Face ID , and users will be able to enable a secondary authentication method via an iPhone if they wish. The iPhone will also serve as a fallback solution for when the hub cannot identify a user correctly. In dark rooms, a Mac-style Edge Light feature will illuminate the area around the screen to help the camera recognize the user. The device purportedly blends interface elements of the Apple Watch, Apple TV , and iPad . Siri AI continues to feature the dark visual style used on other devices. iPhone-style widgets are available and users can choose a wallpaper and rearrange apps and widgets by pressing and holding them, just like Apple's other devices. The UI is heavily built around slideshows and clock displays, similar to the revamped StandBy Mode on the iPhone Duo . One clock is said to resemble "a lava lamp with an overlay of the time that shows the hour in digital form with minutes listed below." Users can then swipe up from the clock screen or photos to open the app launcher. The device will include many of Apple's most frequently used apps, including Calendar, Messages, Photos , ‌FaceTime‌, Notes, Reminders, Music and Podcasts. The Home Screen features Apple Watch-style apps that open into iPad-style interfaces with multiple panels. For example, the Messages app has a two-panel layout like it does on the ‌iPad‌. When a user taps a thread in their list of conversations, a second pane opens to display the conversation feed. This interface is said to carry over to many of the other default apps. evidence.title: Apple Reportedly Planned to Replace 5,000 Support Employees With AI

units.text: Apple Reportedly Planned to Replace 5,000 Support Employees With AI
Apple recently considered laying off about 5,000 support employees, but it has put those plans on hold indefinitely, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

The report said that Apple believed that AI-powered phone and web agents could take over some of the responsibilities performed by the employees who would have been let go, but Apple is no longer "currently looking to take such a step."

Last month, we reported that customers who call the AppleCare phone number (1-800-APL-CARE) from the U.S. or Canada are now routed to an AI-powered support assistant. While many of Apple's phone systems already had a basic automated operator, the Apple Support phone line is now using a bot powered by generative AI.

The virtual assistant can answer questions and provide step-by-step instructions for troubleshooting issues with your Apple products. It can still transfer you to a human advisor if it cannot answer a specific question, or if you ask to speak to a real person.
It remains to be seen if Apple eventually revisits layoffs and/or reduces hiring for AppleCare roles.
The report said Apple has laid off some other employees in middle management roles in recent weeks, including roughly half a dozen directors.

evidence.discovery_title: The most repairable AirPods ever are still a frustrating mess to get into
evidence.raw_lead: Apple's AirPods 5 have replaceable batteries in the earbuds, but the charging case remains inaccessible even with the best tools available. Here's how iFixit fared in its latest teardown.
evidence.title: The most repairable AirPods ever are still a frustrating mess to get into

units.text: Apple's AirPods 5 have replaceable batteries in the earbuds, but the charging case remains inaccessible even with the best tools available. Here's how iFixit fared in its latest teardown.

The AirPods line has always been a thorn in Apple's side, at least when it comes to environmental responsibility. These earbuds and charging case have always been irreparable hunks of plastic destined for a garbage dump at the end of their short life.
However, iFixit has discovered a small glimmer of hope in the AirPods 5. The long-running repairability score for AirPods has been zero, until the latest model received a slight bump to two.
The charging case is still impossible to access, so there's no saving that no matter how skilled you are with a knife and heat gun. The improved score is owed entirely to a change in the earbuds.
Subscribe to AppleInsider on YouTube
When properly clamped with a bit of heat, a technician can remove the earbud's outer cover and expose the battery. That battery comes free from a bit of glue, and is attached via two prongs.
Each earbud has an opposite polarity battery, so the batteries aren't interchangeable between the earbuds. At the least, it seems users can save their earbuds from the garbage with a battery swap.

The charging case has a larger battery, so it theoretically will take longer to reach end-of-life. However, when that happens, the owner has no choice but to buy a new charging case or a whole new set of AirPods.
An accessible battery goes a long way for repairability. Image source: iFixit

Out of all of Apple's products, AirPods are the ones that are consistently the worst for repairability. If Apple wants to reach its goals for Apple 2030 and reduce waste, getting more repairable products to the consumer has to be a priority.

Perhaps Apple will learn how to introduce a more repairable charging case in AirPods Pro 4. Until then, expect to have to buy a whole new pair of AirPods every two to three years as the batteries age and die.

Emergency SOS via satellite is now available in Norway, according to an Apple support document updated today.

Available on the iPhone 14 and newer and the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and newer, Emergency SOS via satellite lets you text emergency services when you are in a supported area without Wi-Fi or cellular connectivity. units.text: Apple will let customers set up their iPhone Duo pre-order starting October 12, four days before orders open on October 16.

Apple's first foldable iPhone, known as the iPhone Duo, debuted on September 9, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. While the latter two are already available for purchase, those looking to get an iPhone Duo will have to wait until mid-October 2026.
Pre-orders for iPhone Duo start at 8 AM ET on Friday, October 16, but Apple says its customers can "get ready" for pre-orders starting October 12.

In essence, it will be possible to customize your iPhone Duo even before pre-orders officially open. From October 12 through October 15, you can select your desired accessories, color, carrier, storage option, shipping address, billing address, AppleCare+ plan, and payment method.

Preparing in advance will let you pre-order the iPhone Duo much more quickly, and it might help you acquire the device on its scheduled release day. Given the rumors around limited supply chain output, you'll want every advantage you can get when ordering the iPhone Duo.
Apple says iPhone Duo availability begins on October 23.

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，彭博社马克 · 古尔曼刚刚报道称，苹果计划于当地时间 10 月 13 日大举进军智能家居市场，届时将推出旗下首款智能家居控制中枢（Home Hub）产品，以及 2027 款 HomePod mini 和新款 Apple TV。
这将是苹果新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯上任后的一次关键产品线扩张。苹果希望借助新一代 Siri AI，将智能家居设备与其现有生态进一步连接。
苹果首款智能家居控制中枢将采用约 6 英寸的方形显示屏，支持壁挂和桌面摆放。
其中，代号 J490 的桌面版配有圆形金属底座，屏幕则通过金属支臂连接，用户可以手动调整俯仰角度；机身采用灰色铝制外壳，并通过 USB-C 接口供电。
壁挂版代号为 J491，屏幕下方配有一块较薄的方形底座，用于容纳扬声器和麦克风。与桌面版一样不内置电池，需要外接供电。
这款设备的主要特点之一是支持家庭成员识别。它可以通过语音或面部识别判断当前使用者，并根据对应的 Apple 账户展示联系人、信息、日历、备忘录以及个性化应用布局。当另一名家庭成员靠近时，界面可以自动切换；访客模式下则会隐藏个人信息。
消息人士称，其面部识别的准确性低于 iPhone（Face ID）。如果用户开启二次身份确认选项，它还可以要求用户通过 iPhone 完成二次认证。当设备无法准确识别用户时，iPhone 也可以作为备用方式完成验证。
在光线较暗的环境中，该设备会通过屏幕周围的虚拟白色环形灯进行补光（照亮摄像头附近区域），以帮助识别使用者。由于产品主要固定放置在室内，因此仅配备一颗前置 FaceTime 摄像头，没有后置摄像头。
按照苹果的计划，用户可在家中不同位置部署多台设备，可用于控制恒温器、门锁等智能家居产品，也可以承担视频通话、类似对讲机的家庭通信、音乐播放以及播放 iCloud 上的幻灯片等功能。
厨房预计也是该设备的重要使用场景。用户可以通过语音查询食谱、观看视频，或者在烹饪过程中进行 FaceTime 通话。据介绍，该设备的扬声器和麦克风位于底座内，整体厚度约与 iPhone 相当。
在外观设计上，桌面版采用圆角方形屏幕和黑色边框，底座周围布置多圈扬声器开孔。整体造型类似 2002 年的 iMac G4，即显示屏安装在半球形底座上。设备没有电源键和音量键，必须一直连接电源。
古尔曼称，J490 的系统 UI 融合了 Apple Watch、Apple TV 和 iPad 的设计元素，包括类似 iPad 的应用布局、Apple Watch 风格图标，以及用于显示股票、日历和天气信息的 iPhone 风格小组件。
设备闲置时可显示照片幻灯片和时钟，而且部分时钟采用类似“熔岩灯”的视觉效果，时间以数字形式叠加显示。用户可以从时钟或照片界面向上滑动进入应用启动器，并通过长按调整壁纸、应用和小组件的位置。
其预装 App 包括日历、信息、照片、FaceTime、备忘录、提醒事项、音乐和播客等。其中，信息应用采用类似 iPad 的双栏设计，用户点击左侧会话列表后，右侧区域显示具体对话内容。
▲ Amazon Echo
此外，苹果届时还将推出新款 HomePod mini。这将是该产品自 2020 年发布以来的首次硬件更新，整体外观预计保持不变，但会采用新款处理器，以支持新一代 Siri AI。据称，新款 HomePod mini 还将增加绿色、粉色等配色。另外，苹果也在计划在推出尺寸更大的 HomePod 迭代版。
Apple TV 也将迎来 2022 年以来的首次更新，预计同样沿用现有外观，但会换用更快的处理器，以满足新一代 Siri AI 的需求。
很显然，苹果新一代智能家居产品的核心能力均来自新一代 Siri AI。该系统可结合用户个人数据回答问题，同时支持联网搜索获取信息，还能够自然地控制其它 Apple 设备、智能家居产品和应用。
由于 Siri AI 的开发进度多次延期，苹果原本计划在更早时间推出这批智能家居设备，但产品发布也随之推迟。随着新一代 Siri 登陆 iPhone、iPad、Mac 等设备，苹果也终于具备推出相关硬件的条件。
除上述硬件外，苹果还在继续扩展智能家居生态，进一步完善 HomeKit，并与第三方厂商合作开发适配 Siri AI 家庭平台的新型联网设备。IT之家后续将保持关注。
苹果还在开发一款代号 J450 的隐私型家庭安防摄像头和传感器，可判断人员所在房间，但不会进行视频录制。
除 J490 外，苹果还在开发更高级的智能家居控制中枢版本，该产品配备更大的 9 英寸屏幕，并可通过机械臂移动屏幕，甚至可以实现 360° 旋转。当然，该产品仍处于开发早期，具体发布时间尚未确定。

evidence.title: Safety concerns forced ICEblock removal, Apple tells lawmaker

units.text: Apple has doubled down on its claims that removing ICEblock and similar apps from the App Store was necessary for safety, though chiefly because it was never going to admit to bowing to government pressure.

In July 2025, the Department of Justice publicly threatened the developer of ICEblock, an app that let users say when Immigration and Enforcement Officers were spotted in an area. The app was intended to help people avoid trouble spots, such as the riots caused when ICE agents entered Los Angeles against the city mayor's orders.

Apple is now being asked to justify how in October 2025, it subsequently removed ICEblock from the App Store. Only excerpts of Apple's latest comments have been reported, but CNN says that the company's July 2026 letter doubled down on safety as the reason for the removal.

The letter, written in response to Rep. Jamie Raskin (D) of the House Judiciary Committee, reportedly says that then-Attorney General Pam Bondi had "expressed serious concerns to Apple that ICEBlock posed a threat to the safety of federal officers."

This had been followed by FBI Director Kash Patel claiming that apps such a ICEblock had been used to track agents. That statement was specifically about a shooting at an ICE facility in September 2025, which wasn't related to the ICEBlock app, given that the building obviously wasn't in motion, and was known as an ICE facility for over a decade.
Apple also says that it saw a "significant increase in ICE activity and threats against ICE" around this time.

Therefore, says Apple, it decided to remove ICEblock and similar apps. Apple does not say that it was ordered to remove the apps, and the DOJ has previously denied issuing any such order. Our research at the time found that there was no legal order, likely to skirt First Amendment arguments since it wasn't a legal request.

Apple says instead that it concluded that ICE-tracking apps were in violation of App Store policies since they gave users "precise location information about ICE officers (and, as a result, other individuals who may be in proximity to ICE agents, such as protestors or detainees), thus providing a potential roadmap for targeted violence and creating a significant risk of harm."
Apple's removal of ICEblock prompted Portland protesters to march on Apple Stores dressed as Santa Claus. Image source: keir-pdx on Bluesky

The published excerpts from the letter continue with Apple saying that it "does not take decisions about removing apps from the App Store lightly, but acts when it must — especially when there are serious concerns that an app is creating safety risks."
Why Raskin is investigating
ICEblock did not induce violence against agents, but the DOJ and FBI said that it did. After they said that, Apple removed the apps.
Apple will of course never say that it bowed to government pressure. But it appears to be solely repeating the safety argument that Rep. Raskin in his initial letter to the company refused to accept.

Raskin had pointed out that the September 2025 shooter "did not need a tracking app to locate the fixed position of a government building." According to Raskin, the shooter had also been "reported to have found the address using an app that comes standard on Apple devices," and which was not removed.
"Monitoring the actions of federal immigration authorities who have been deployed to (users') neighborhoods, is a core First Amendment right and not a crime," Raskin said.

The questions that Raskin first asked Apple can be read in full online. He began investigating both Apple and Google back in February 2026, and his later letter required detailed explanations of what apps were removed and why.
Apple has not commented publicly. The DOJ has also not spoken about Raskin's letter or Apple's response, but it has continued to claim that ICE apps are dangerous.

"Our law officers are facing an over 1,600% increase in assaults, a 3,300% increase in vehicle attacks, and an 8,000% increase in death threats," said a Department of Homeland Security (DHS) spokesperson. "Further, these apps are a method to interfere with law enforcement activities and harbor illegal aliens."

ICEblock and similar apps are not illegal, in the same way that Apple Maps pinpointing speed traps is not illegal. The DHS has not commented on reasons why alleged assaults against ICE agents are up, it has only targeted apps.
And, locations were generally after-the-fact data. User reports tended towards where ICE action was, not is, and lagged a half-hour or more behind actual movements.
What happens next

Given that Apple's response to Raskin has not been published fully, it's not clear what else the company may have said. It isn't known whether Raskin will consider the matter closed, nor yet what steps he or the House Judiciary Committee could take next.

But what Apple must be hoping will happen next is that the whole issue be forgotten. Apple can say it wasn't ordered to remove the apps, and the DOJ can say it never made such an order, but effectively that is what happened.

Apple will remove apps that are against the law, and ICEBlock is not. This time, it bowed to government pressure and given the the administration's willingness to punish companies on a whim, it is understandable.
But it's also an abdication of Apple's stated morals on free speech for individuals.

evidence.discovery_lead: DoorDash is inviting U.S. customers to join a waitlist for an AI assistant that can take food orders through Apple's Messages app (via Bloomberg ). The phone number used in the conversation connects the request to a customer's DoorDash account. The assistant can use previous purchases and preferences to help put together an order, then use a saved payment method at checkout. Customers can also view food photos in the chat or send a picture of their fridge for recipe ideas and suggestions for missing ingredients. The service builds on Ask DoorDash , which launched inside the DoorDash app in June. DoorDash describes the message assistant as a pilot for select U.S. account holders and advises users to check their carts before paying because the AI can make mistakes. To join the beta waitlist, U.S. iOS users can enter their phone number at doordash.com/text and select Continue. DoorDash says Android support is coming soon. evidence.raw_lead: 受益于艾美奖多项大奖加持、多部新内容上线，叠加 iCloud+ 捆绑权益扩容，Apple TV 近期创下开播以来单周最高收视纪录，同比大涨 67%。#Apple TV 收视动态#
evidence.title: 斩获 29 项艾美奖叠加新内容上线，苹果 Apple TV 创下开播以来单周最高收视纪录

units.text: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，据 Deadline 报道，凭借斩获 29 项艾美奖以及《足球教练》（Ted Lasso）、《求救信号（Mayday）》等新上线内容的拉动，Apple TV 近期创下开播以来单周最高收视纪录。
几周之前，Apple TV 打破自身纪录，一共拿下 29 座艾美奖杯；其中黑马热剧《寡妇湾（Widow's Bay）》独揽 14 项大奖。
差不多同一时段，《流人（Slow Horses）》新季回归；由瑞安 · 雷诺兹、肯尼思 · 布拉纳领衔主演的影片《求救信号（Mayday）》正式上线；万众期待的《足球教练（Ted Lasso）》第四季也同步推出。
据报道，多重利好叠加之下，9 月 14 日所在的这一周，Apple TV 取得了平台有史以来最高的单周收视数据，同比大涨 67%。
苹果方面表示，9 月 4 日直接上线流媒体的电影《求救信号（Mayday）》，在上线之后的前 18 天，已经成为 Apple TV 平台有史以来首映表现最好的电影。
在美国市场，根据 Luminate 发布的 9 月 4‑10 日周度榜单，该片上线首周拿下榜单第一名，播放量达到 870 万次；第二周热度依旧居高不下，位列第二名。
报道同时提到，据 Apple TV 的数据，在一举斩获包括最佳喜剧剧集在内的 14 项大奖之后，《寡妇湾（Widow's Bay）》在艾美奖结束后的那一周，周环比播放量暴涨 280%。
报道称，收视上涨在美国、英国、加拿大、澳大利亚、巴西、墨西哥、德国、印度、波兰以及西班牙这些国家表现尤为突出。
另外，剧集《Pluribus》同样收获艾美红利，一共拿下六项奖项，其中蕾亚 · 希霍恩（Rhea Seehorn）摘得剧情类剧集最佳女主角。苹果的数据显示，艾美颁奖礼过后，该剧周环比播放量激增 200%。
报道称，艾美奖与新上线剧集固然是收视冲高的主要推手，而苹果近期对 iCloud+ 权益的扩容或许也起到了助推作用。
本月早些时候，苹果开始在超过 100 个国家和地区，把 Apple TV 权益免费捆绑进 iCloud+ 订阅套餐。这也同时让该流媒体服务首次进入 59 个全新市场，整体覆盖范围扩大至 170 个国家与地区。
Apple TV 单独订阅价格为每月 14.99 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 100.8 元人民币），也可以纳入 Apple One 捆绑套餐。

evidence.raw_lead: It’s worth upgrading your iPhone’s camera app.
evidence.title: The Halide camera app now offers full control of the iPhone 18 Pro’s aperture

units.text: A new update to Lux Optics’ anti-algorithm Halide camera app for the iPhone and iPad adds two new photography looks and support for the variable aperture on the new iPhone 18 Pro’s main camera. Halide isn’t the first alternative to the native iOS camera app to add support for the new feature, but it offers more finite control over aperture settings than other third-party apps.

The iOS camera app limits aperture adjustments to just four presets, but both the BlackMagic Camera and Moment Pro Camera II apps expand that to 10 presets in 1/3 stop increments, similar to what most digital cameras offer. Halide Mark III goes even further by letting you select any f-stop setting from f/1.48 down to f/4.0. Although it’s hard to imagine you’ll see any noticeable difference between f/4.0 and f/3.99, the option is available. The Halide developers are also considering adding f-stop presets in future updates based on user feedback.

[Image: The new Dawn look (left) adds warmth to images while Quicksilver (right) mutes colors and boosts contrast. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/halide2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

Halide Mark III launched earlier this year with added features including a new film simulation engine and multiple looks that can be applied to photos. Today’s update adds a new Dawn look to the collection that applies “filmic warmth in the mid-tones and highlights with gentle, rich shadows” and Quicksilver, which “pairs high contrast with muted color, inspired by silver-retention processes.”
The new Dawn look (left) adds warmth to images while Quicksilver (right) mutes colors and boosts contrast.

units.text: Today Apple TV unveiled the trailer for Nocturne, a new thriller series based on bestselling crime novel “The Sandman” by Lars Kepler.
Nocturne is new thriller series premiering October 30
Apple TV has a variety of exciting crime thrillers in its library, and this fall it plans to add even more.
One of those series—Nocturne—is based on the bestselling novel “The Sandman” by Lars Kepler.
Nocturne premieres Friday, October 30 with two episodes, followed by weekly releases through December 25.
The show revolves around a serial killer and stars Liev Schreiber and Zazie Beetz, with Stephen Graham (“Adolescence”) as the killer.
Apple just released the trailer, offering our first proper preview of the chilling new show. Here’s the official summary for Nocturne, followed by the trailer.

“Nocturne” tells the story of Jonah Lynn (Schreiber), an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter (Graham), Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek’s last missing victim forces Jonah to send his surrogate daughter FBI Agent Saga Bauer (Beetz), up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

Two weeks before Nocturne, ‘12 12 12’ premieres on Apple TV as another crime thriller. It stars Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan and centers around a heist, covering the 12 months of planning, 12 hours of the heist itself, and 12 days following it.
Looking beyond the fall, Apple plans to kick off 2027 with the high-profile thriller The Wanted Man, which stars Hugh Laurie as an organized crime boss.
Do you plan to watch Nocturne when it premieres next month? Let us know in the comments.
Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.

units.text: In May, Lux Optics launched the all-new Halide Mark III pro camera app for iPhone. Today, Halide is back with its first update for iPhone 18 Pro, plus new features for all iPhone photographers.
Halide Mark III is all about enabling iPhone users to take better photos.
It includes a redesigned camera, a new photo editor, and Halide looks, which give your shots specific styles.
Halide 3.1 arrived in July, building on top of the release with an additional Halide look and more.
Halide Mark III pro camera for iPhone arrives with three key photography upgrades
Halide 3.1 adds perspective correction, RAW-only capture, more
Now Halide 3.2 is here, and it’s ready for the upgraded iPhone 18 Pro camera system.
Aperture Priority mode
This includes Aperture Priority mode, which builds on Halide’s ability to select any f-number between ƒ/1.48 and ƒ/4.0.
(The built-in Camera app supports automatic variable aperture mode, or manually selecting ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8, or ƒ/4.0.)
Halide 3.2’s Aperture Priority mode for iPhone 18 Pro lets you set a target f-number, then Halide adjusts the shutter speed and ISO based on the shot.
Fully manual mode enables direct ISO control as well.
New Halide looks: dawn and quicksilver
Additionally, Halide 3.2 adds two new looks for all iPhones: dawn and quicksilver.
Dawn “offers filmic warmth in the mid-tones and highlights with gentle, rich shadows” while quicksilver “pairs high contrast with muted color, inspired by silver-retention processes.”
Lastly, Halide 3.2 introduces 16:9 aspect ratio shooting mode.
Halide Mark III can be purchased outright for $69.99, or subscribers can access the new app for $19.99/year.

This includes Aperture Priority mode, which builds on Halide’s ability to select any f-number between ƒ/1.48 and ƒ/4.0.
(The built-in Camera app supports automatic variable aperture mode, or manually selecting ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8, or ƒ/4.0.)
Halide 3.2’s Aperture Priority mode for iPhone 18 Pro lets you set a target f-number, then Halide adjusts the shutter speed and ISO based on the shot.
Additionally, Halide 3.2 adds two new looks for all iPhones: dawn and quicksilver.
Lastly, Halide 3.2 introduces 16:9 aspect ratio shooting mode.
Halide Mark III can be purchased outright for $69.99, or subscribers can access the new app for $19.99/year.

units.text: Apple’s long-awaited smart home hub, which we’ve been referring to as the HomePad, is set to launch on October 13, according to Bloomberg.
The device is said to feature a 6-inch display and a design inspired by the iMac G4, and will launch alongside a HomePod mini update with new colors and a new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI support …
A previous report from the same source had said only that it was expected to launch “as soon as October,” but the latest report specifies October 13th.
Apple Inc. plans to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on Oct. 13, marking a critical product expansion for the company under new Chief Executive Officer John Ternus.

The iMac G4 was one of the company’s most iconic designs, with a hemispherical base and a free-floating screen that could be rotated, raised, lowered, and tilted to position it anywhere you wanted. I said a year ago that I very much hoped Apple would bring back this beautiful design for the upcoming product.
It’s previously been reported that the device will come in two versions: the tabletop one referenced here, and a second version intended to be mounted on a wall.

The upcoming device is expected to include a speaker to enable it to act as a HomePod as well as a smart home control panel. It’s expected to have a new operating system combining elements of iOS, tvOS, and watchOS – and to center around Siri AI.

Daring Fireball separately suggested that iPhone Duo review models would be handed over to tech writers on October 13 or 14, and that as Apple likes to do this in-person for high-profile products it would make sense to combine this with an event for the new products.
Today’s report says that the device is codenamed J490. Do you expect to buy one? Please share your thoughts in the comments.

evidence.discovery_title: Apple releases new guide to help families build healthy digital habits
evidence.raw_lead: Today, in partnership with the American Academy of Pediatrics, Apple released a new guide to help families create healthy digital habits.
evidence.title: Apple releases new guide to help families build healthy digital habits

units.text: Today, in partnership with the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), Apple released a new guide to help families create healthy digital habits that balance screen time with sleep, exercise, schoolwork, and time with friends and family. The AAP’s expert guidance has been tailored for Apple’s new parental controls in “Building Healthy Digital Habits: A Guide for Families.” “Every family approaches technology in their own way,” said Sumbul Desai, M.D., Apple’s vice president of Health and Fitness. “That’s why we wanted to combine trusted guidance from the American Academy of Pediatrics with the tools built into our products. Together, they’re designed to adapt to each family and each child’s stage of development, giving parents a useful starting point to decide what works best. Our hope is that this guide helps facilitate easier discussions and gives families the resources they need to put this guidance into practice, adjust their approach as their child grows, and help them develop healthy digital habits they can carry into everyday life.” This guide walks families through six steps:
Start a conversation about screen time, with tips for parents to approach the topic and establish expectations in a way that helps kids feel included in the plan.
Create a Child Account, which enables age-based safeguards and gives parents access to parental controls to manage their child’s experience.
Set safety settings for websites and apps, including Ask to Buy and Ask to Browse, so families can review new apps and websites together.
Make a schedule for device use, using Time Allowances and Schedules to balance time online with sleep, schoolwork, physical activity, and time with family and friends.

Manage communications, with parents deciding who their child can communicate with and Communication Safety, on by default for all users under 18, helping protect kids from viewing or sharing sensitive content.
Continue the conversation as kids grow, with guidance on adjusting the family’s plan over time.

There’s also more detailed information on the AAP’s screen time guidance by age group, from infants to teens, to help families consider their choices around media use. “At AAP, our focus is equipping pediatricians and families with trusted science-based guidance to support informed decisions at every stage of a child’s life, including building healthy digital habits,” said Mark Del Monte, the AAP’s chief executive officer. “We are proud to partner with Apple to expand access to the Family Media Plan, helping parents create routines that promote balance, safety, and healthy development. We know that navigating screens and social media is something every parent wants to get right, and this partnership will further support families with those efforts.” Learn more about Apple’s approach to child safety. Availability New features are available now with the Screen Time update in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27. All products in a Family Sharing group must be updated to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27 to use the Screen Time update. Some features may not be available in all regions, in all languages, or on all models. For more information about availability, visit apple.com.

evidence.discovery_title: 苹果更新 Apple 创作坊：Mac 版 Final Cut Pro 可为 iPhone 18 Pro 拍摄视频添加电影效果
evidence.raw_lead: Apple 为 Apple 创作坊推出多项功能更新，涵盖 Pixelmator Pro、Final Cut Pro、iWork 三件套、无边记等多个 app，新增各类工具与模板优化创作体验。
evidence.title: 苹果更新 Apple 创作坊：Mac 版 Final Cut Pro 可为 iPhone 18 Pro 拍摄视频添加电影效果

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，苹果公司今天（9 月 30 日）更新 Apple 创作坊，覆盖 Pixelmator Pro、Final Cut Pro、Motion、Keynote、Pages、Numbers 与无边记等应用。
IT之家注：Apple 创作坊（Apple Creator Studio）是苹果推出的创意与生产力类 App 订阅服务，整合视频剪辑、音乐制作、图像设计和文档创作工具，订阅后可使用 Final Cut Pro、Logic Pro、Pixelmator Pro 等专业 App 及其高级内容。
创作方向 | 主要 App | 适合做什么
视频 | Final Cut Pro、Motion、Compressor | 剪辑课程视频、短视频、宣传片、讲座录像
音乐 | Logic Pro、MainStage | 编曲、录音、混音、现场演出
图像 | Pixelmator Pro | 修图、海报、缩略图、社交媒体图片
生产力 | Keynote、Pages、Numbers、无边记 | 做演示文稿、课程材料、表格和头脑风暴
Pixelmator Pro
Mac 版和 iPad 版 Pixelmator Pro 新增了两个模板集，其中一个用于设计体育运动和动作类项目，另一个用于新创意、商务或产品发布。新增的“播客”类别下包括为展示播客节目而设计的封面插图，可调整尺寸以适应各主流播客平台。
iPad 版 Pixelmator Pro 新增“选择和蒙版”功能。该功能提供更细致的选择与蒙版控制，能够处理头发、毛发等复杂边缘，并保留相关细节。
Mac 版 Final Cut Pro 和 Motion
Mac 版 Final Cut Pro 和 Motion 现可通过新的方式为 iPhone 18 Pro 拍摄的原生视频添加电影效果模式特效。剪辑师可直接在 Final Cut Pro 时间线上调整焦点与景深。
Compressor 可供剪辑师将具有电影效果模式特效的视频转换回原先的电影效果模式格式，并新增 HEVC 和 MPEG-4 格式导出预置，方便分享到社交媒体。
Keynote 讲演、Pages 文稿和 Numbers 表格
Apple 创作坊订阅用户可在 Keynote 讲演、Pages 文稿和 Numbers 表格中使用全新专业设计的模板和主题。
Keynote 讲演、Pages 文稿和 Numbers 表格用户可请求访问共享的演示文稿、文档或电子表格，更轻松地开展协作，即时获得帮助。
Mac 版 Pages 文稿 app 新增屏幕视图，可优化内容以方便阅读和专注写作；Numbers 表格 app 新增三角函数、统计函数和逻辑函数，支持在电子表格中解答复杂问题。
无边记
无边记 app 新增多项备受用户期待的功能。看板现在可自动适应深色模式，用户可使用文件夹将不同看板整理进不同精选集，并邀请他人协作。用户还可请求访问共享文件以加入协作，或使用快捷指令自动添加内容。
在 visionOS 27 中，无边记 app 变得更加强大，用户可将看板上的多项内容拉入自己的空间，包括图像、视频、便笺条、形状和 3D 模型等，并能以群组形式查看 3D 模型。
费用方面，官方售价信息如下：
普通用户：免费试用 1 个月，之后 38 元 / 月或 380 元 / 年。
高校学生和教育工作者：免费试用 1 个月，之后 18 元 / 月或 180 元 / 年，需要通过资格验证。
购买符合条件的新 Mac 或 iPad：可免费试用 3 个月，每个 Apple 账户通常仅限一次。

evidence.discovery_title: Small layoffs and budget cuts are hitting Apple, with more expected
evidence.raw_lead: New Apple CEO John Ternus is reportedly planning layoffs ranging from small-scale ones in large teams, but also cancelling projects.
evidence.title: Small layoffs and budget cuts are hitting Apple, with more expected

units.text: New Apple CEO John Ternus is reportedly planning layoffs ranging from small-scale ones in large teams, but also cancelling projects.

Apple has recently laid off some staff from Apple Vision Pro development, but a new report says that employees across the company are expecting more serious numbers of redundancies to come. According to Bloomberg, it's a result of new CEO Ternus aiming to cut costs and focus on developing fewer products.
The report also claims, though, that some of the layoffs were linked to employee performance. So at least some of the layoffs appear to be more due to efficiency than to budget cutting.

At the same time, Ternus is said to be canceling some projects that are early in their development. He's believed to be doing this in order to focus on changing how often Apple releases new and updated products.
Layoffs are not certain

Canceling projects is likely to mean layoffs, but it's not clear when or really whether these cuts will happen, though. That's because the report also cites Ternus cancelling a plan to lay off around 5,000 AppleCare customer service staff.
It had been expected that AI would be able to perform some of their tasks, but Apple is said to have put these plans on hold.

The expectation that more layoffs are coming is more because of changes to budgets. Reportedly some Apple divisions had been led to expect budget and headcount increases in 2027, but those are now not going to happen.

That does not mean there won't be any increase in budget, but it's said that the headcount is being kept flat. That typically means no recruitment and at most only replacing people who leave or are redeployed.

There have reportedly been a small number of layoffs in Apple Fitness+. But given how that service retains its main costs such as studio space, that is more likely to be refocusing what the service provides rather than saving money.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，据科技媒体 Bleeping Computer 今天报道，远程桌面软件 TeamViewer 被曝存在多个高危漏洞，官方已着手修复， 并敦促客户尽快更新最新版软件 。 IT之家了解到，本次事件最严重的漏洞是 CVE-2026-92370，源于 TeamViewer Full Client 和 Host 软件中的访问控制缺陷，影响 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统。黑客可利用其执行未授权操作，在目标设备上实现远程代码执行。 同时，本次事件还存在 CVE-2026-19743、CVE-2026-92368、CVE-2026-92369 和 CVE-2026-92371。上述漏洞如被黑客利用，可使用用户权限远程执行代码，或提权至 NT AUTHORITY / SYSTEM 或 root 级别。 TeamViewer 已推出 15.82 版客户端修复上述漏洞， 官方强烈建议所有用户尽快升级至最新版本 。

TeamViewer 已推出 15.82 版客户端修复上述漏洞，官方强烈建议所有用户尽快升级至最新版本。

evidence.title: 特努斯期望重塑苹果 “用更少人做更多的事” - Apple 苹果 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 苹果新任首席执行官John Ternus上任仅数周便着手重塑这家iPhone制造商，希望籍此加快产品开发、扩大设备阵容，打造更精简、更加注重工程的组织架构。知情人士称，Ternus已在内部与同事讨论相关计划，初步设想包括减少对传统春季和秋季产品发布周期的依赖，取消部分中层管理职位，以减少工程师与高管之间的管理层级。
Ternus认为，在人工智能时代，苹果要保持竞争力就必须更快推出产品，并在产品开发上更大胆尝试。
苹果首席执行官John Ternus
知情人士称，公司已启动削减成本的举措，随着服务业务增长放缓，Ternus还在寻找新的收入来源，并设法从现有产品中获得更多收入。
苹果明年计划推出大量新产品，包括配备摄像头的AirPods、首款智能眼镜，以及为纪念iPhone问世20周年而重新设计的iPhone。
Ternus还在考虑调整产品发布时点。过去十年大部分时间，苹果的产品和工程团队都围绕秋季大型发布会展开工作，偶尔也会在春季推出新品。
Ternus希望公司可以更频繁地推出产品，不仅是春秋，而是全年任何时候。不过员工表示，要改变苹果长期形成的开发方式并不容易，可能需要数年时间。
现年51岁的Ternus多年来一直主张精简组织。他在负责硬件工程时曾在全员会议上表示，苹果应该减少招聘，让现有工程师承担更多工作、削减组织冗余。他还曾展示一张年度员工人数增长图，主张公司应以更少员工完成更多工作。
这种理念类似Meta和谷歌等硅谷公司的快节奏文化已开始在苹果内部落地。
过去两周，苹果硬件工程部门开始裁撤部分工程项目经理（EPM）。这一岗位几十年来一直是苹果产品开发流程中的核心角色，负责管理时间表并协调不同团队之间的工作。此次调整影响了多名项目经理，包括大约六名总监级员工，属于苹果内部较高的职级。
这些员工只获得数周时间在内部寻找其他职位。没能找到新岗位的将在今年晚些时候被裁员。此类裁员过去在苹果并不常见，但近几个月已经越来越频繁。
据悉苹果已在多个团队内进行小规模裁员，并在产品开发的更早阶段缩减或取消项目，尤其是那些被认为对利润贡献不大的项目。
苹果园区
相关行动包括大幅削减Siri、Vision Pro头显以及AI相关软件工程团队的人员，其中部分调整与员工绩效有关。苹果最近还小幅裁减了Fitness+团队，该部门此前一直在开发仅提供音频的健身课程版本。
此外，Ternus还在研究如何利用AI加快产品开发，并接手目前由员工完成的部分工作。
今年夏天，苹果曾制定了一项计划，考虑裁减约5000名AppleCare客户服务人员，包括许多居家办公员工。该计划基于一种判断，即更完善的AI电话和网页智能体能够接手他们部分工作。但该公司最终搁置了这项计划，目前也没有准备采取这一措施。
尽管如此，许多员工仍认为，今年晚些时候或明年初可能进一步裁员。多个部门在为2027年进行早期规划时，原本考虑了增加预算和员工人数的可能性。但在一些部门，计划中的预算增幅被下调，人员规模则维持同比不变。另一些团队还被要求削减营销支出。
影响全行业的内存芯片短缺推高了关键零部件成本，苹果已通过涨价来抵消更高的成本支出，但他们不希望看到消费者因价格过高而离开，因此至少目前，苹果选择自行消化部分成本。
产品开发部门的管理人员已经感受到节奏加快带来的压力。一名知情人士表示：“现在所有事情都比过去更需要亲自参与，眼下非常忙乱。”该人士及其他知情人士称，产品开发团队的管理人员正被要求以更短周期、更高频率推出更多产品。
随着苹果服务业务增速放缓、App Store的商业模式承压，Ternus和服务业务负责人Eddy Cue以及首席财务官Kevan Parekh也在寻找新的增收方式。，他们讨论过推出新服务，以及从现有产品和服务中获取更多收入。
与此同时，削减成本仍将继续。对于即将到来的公司节日聚会，一些团队已被告知，多年来将首次不再允许员工携伴参加。

evidence.title: 三星推出Galaxy SmartTag 3追踪器 体积更小、续航更长并支持iPhone - Samsung 三星 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 三星发布第三代蓝牙追踪器Galaxy SmartTag 3。新款采用圆角方形设计，整体类似第一代SmartTag，但取消了钥匙圈开孔；若要直接挂在钥匙或登山扣上，用户需另购三星保护壳。设备具备IP67防尘防水等级，较SmartTag 2体积缩小35%、重量减轻33%，能效提高10%。
SmartTag 3使用可更换的CR2032纽扣电池，普通使用情况下续航最长约550天，省电模式下最长约790天。新款还首次扩展支持iOS设备，便于用户与朋友、家人或遛狗者共享追踪信息，协助寻找遗失物品或宠物。三星似乎并未将其定位为吸引AirTag用户的直接替代品；目前公司是否也会支持其他Android手机仍待确认。
追踪功能由三星Galaxy Find网络提供，而非GoogleFind Hub。用户可设置设备进入或离开指定区域时接收提醒，也能启用移动侦测，在追踪器发生较小位移时收到通知，并查看位置历史记录。当手机距离追踪器约200英尺以内时，兼容手机可结合超宽带（UWB）和蓝牙6.0信道探测技术，实现更精确的定位。
该产品提供黑、白两种颜色，10月7日起在韩国开售，美国市场预计于11月初上市，单只售价29.99美元，四件装售价99.99美元，与SmartTag 2的定价相同，也与苹果最新款AirTag和GooglePixel Tag价格相近。

evidence.discovery_title: New updates coming to Apple Creator Studio
evidence.raw_lead: Apple today introduced updates to Apple Creator Studio, its groundbreaking collection of creative and productivity apps.
evidence.title: New updates coming to Apple Creator Studio

units.text: Apple today introduced updates to Apple Creator Studio, the powerful collection of creative and productivity apps. Pixelmator Pro for iPad adds edge-refinement tools for advanced selections; native video captured on iPhone 18 Pro can now have Cinematic mode effects applied during editing using Final Cut Pro and Motion; and Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform gain new templates and creative tools. Pixelmator Pro adds two new template collections on Mac and iPad, including designs for sports and action-packed projects, and templates for launching a new creative idea, business, or product. A new Podcasts category introduces cover artwork designed to make shows stand out, sized appropriately for major podcast platforms. Pixelmator Pro for iPad also brings Select and Mask from Mac, giving creatives dedicated controls for precise mask and selection refinements — including the ability to preserve fine detail along complex edges like hair or fur. Final Cut Pro and Motion on Mac bring new ways to add Cinematic mode effects to video captured natively on iPhone 18 Pro. Editors can adjust focus points and depth of field directly in the Final Cut Pro timeline. Compressor lets editors convert video with Cinematic mode effects back into the previous Cinematic mode format, and adds new HEVC and MPEG-4 export presets for social sharing. Apple Creator Studio subscribers get new, professionally designed templates and themes in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. And intelligent slide generation in Keynote now automatically creates images tailored to a presentation. Keynote, Pages, and Numbers users can more easily collaborate and get help in the moment, with the ability to request access to a shared presentation, document, or spreadsheet. Pages for Mac also adds Screen View, which optimizes content for reading and focused writing, and Numbers adds new trigonometry, statistics, and logic functions for solving complex problems in a spreadsheet. Freeform gains several highly requested features. Boards now automatically adapt to Dark Mode, and folders let users organize boards into collections and invite others to collaborate. Writing Tools with Apple Intelligence can rewrite, proofread, and summarize handwritten notes; users can also request access to collaborate on shared files, or automate adding content using Shortcuts. Freeform becomes even more powerful in visionOS 27, letting users pull multiple items from a board — including images, videos, sticky notes, shapes, and 3D models — into their space, and view 3D models together as a group.

units.text: 苹果新任首席执行官约翰·特努斯上任刚满一个月，正考虑调整公司的产品开发和运营方式。一方面，他希望凭借工程背景推动更快的产品研发，让新品在全年陆续发布，而非主要集中在秋季iPhone发布会和春季发布活动；另一方面，他也计划控制成本、缩减部分产品项目，并在大型团队中进行小规模裁员。
目前苹果通常通过固定的秋季和春季发布活动推出新品，特努斯希望提高发布频率、改变这一长期形成的工作模式。不过，接受采访的员工认为，这种根深蒂固的开发流程难以迅速改变，调整可能需要数年时间。
在成本控制方面，苹果近期已裁撤部分Vision Pro开发团队员工。新的报道指出，公司内部员工预期未来还可能出现更大范围的岗位削减，并伴随项目取消；这些变化被认为与特努斯削减开支、集中资源开发较少产品的计划有关。不过，目前尚不清楚裁员会在何时发生，甚至也不能确定相关计划是否最终落实。
苹果此前曾考虑裁撤约5000名AppleCare客服人员，理由是人工智能可能接手部分工作，但特努斯已叫停这一方案。员工对未来裁员的担忧，更多来自预算安排的变化：苹果部分部门原本预期2027年预算和编制会增加，现在这些增长计划将不再推进。
整体来看，特努斯的调整方向并非单纯增加或减少新品，而是试图以更频繁的发布节奏重组产品开发，同时减少项目数量、控制开支并重新分配人力与预算。相关改变涉及苹果长期的开发流程和团队配置，具体实施范围与时间仍未确定。

evidence.discovery_title: iPhone 18 Pro Owners Complain of Speaker Crackling or Popping
evidence.raw_lead: Some iPhone 18 Pro owners have noticed an unusual crackling sound coming from the speaker of the device, leading to complaints on the MacRumors forums and Reddit. Users have called it a crackle, a faint tick or pop, or random clicking. Many say the problem is with the earpiece speaker, and both the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max appear to be affected.
evidence.title: iPhone 18 Pro Owners Complain of Speaker Crackling or Popping

units.text: iPhone 18 Pro Owners Complain of Speaker Crackling or Popping
Some iPhone 18 Pro owners have noticed an unusual crackling sound coming from the speaker of the device, leading to complaints on the MacRumors forums and Reddit.
Users have called it a crackle, a faint tick or pop, or random clicking. Many say the problem is with the earpiece speaker, and both the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max appear to be affected.

Some people hear the sound consistently, while others hear it during app use, scrolling websites, when receiving notifications, when the keyboard pops up, or when making a call using a cellular connection. On affected units, reports suggest toggling Airplane Mode on and off triggers the sound, as does adjusting screen brightness quickly.

Apple released iOS 27.0.1 yesterday to fix a bug that could cause ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models to restart when Face ID authentication fails. The release notes didn't mention a speaker fix, and early feedback says the update did not help.

There are reports from people who returned their ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models only to get a second iPhone with the same issue. It's not clear what's causing the problem, but if it is a bug, a future software update may address it.

units.text: iPhone 18 Pro开售以来，香港警方接获1503宗涉及可疑信用卡交易的报告，涉款超过3000万港元，约合382万美元。警方表示，所有相关交易均已取消。调查显示，诈骗者疑似利用非法取得的信用卡资料大量购买新机。
香港警务处处长周一鸣在九龙城区议会会议上表示，这些交易未触发苹果网店的在线安全和身份验证机制。他将问题归因于苹果网店可能存在的漏洞，但未进一步说明漏洞的具体成因。由于相关验证未启动，买家无需输入一次性密码，也不必通过手机应用确认，犯罪分子因此能够使用非法获取的信用卡资料下大额订单。
据称，苹果网购流程中的身份和付款验证要求在这些交易中被绕过。诈骗者使用VPN，并填写虚假或不完整的收货地址。苹果随后通过电邮要求核实地址，诈骗者便改为提供公共场所作为收货地点。
周一鸣表示，警方已要求苹果检视交易流程，采取措施防止类似诈骗。他还提到，折叠屏手机iPhone Duo预计将于10月上市，暗示警方预计届时相关诈骗尝试可能再次增加。苹果尚未公开回应。
香港犯罪团伙此前曾卷入跨境盗窃案件，苹果在中国的业务发展早期也曾遭遇贿赂和欺诈问题。

evidence.discovery_title: Final Cut Camera updated with support for iPhone 18 Pro features, more - 9to5Mac
evidence.raw_lead: Apple is rolling out a big update to Final Cut Camera today, the pro video app it first released for...
evidence.title: Final Cut Camera updated with support for iPhone 18 Pro features, more - 9to5Mac

units.text: Apple is rolling out a big update to Final Cut Camera today, the pro video app it first released for iPhone back in 2024. The update introduces a new design along with support for variable aperture on iPhone 18 Pro.

For those unfamiliar, Apple touts Final Cut Camera as a way to “record professional videos with full control of your footage and connect to Final Cut Pro for iPad to capture multiple angles at once with Live Multicam.” Apple announced the app in May 2024 and released it a month later.
Final Cut Camera version 2.4 is rolling out today with multiple key changes. First, it introduces a new, more customizable design with easier access to different settings.

The update also adds support for iPhone 18 Pro’s variable aperture, from f/1.48 to f/4, including shutter priority, aperture priority, and manual modes. It also supports Cinematic mode effects on iPhone 18 Pro, including video shot in ProRes and Apple Log.

With iPhone 18 Pro, users can take advantage of the new Fusion Main camera with variable aperture — the most advanced camera Apple has ever made — which brings aperture control to iPhone for the first time. Final Cut Camera allows creators to precisely dial in their aperture settings, or choose between shutter priority and aperture priority modes, to record stunning videos. The update also unlocks Cinematic mode effects for regular video, including footage captured in ProRes and Apple Log, allowing creators to adjust focus points and depth of field while editing in Final Cut Pro.
You can download Final Cut Camera on the App Store. The new update will start rolling out today. The app requires a subscription to Apple Creator Studio, which is $12.99 per month or $129 per year.

evidence.discovery_title: iPhone 18 Pro Face ID Not Working? Try This
evidence.raw_lead: Apple's latest iPhone 18 Pro models came out mid-September to much fanfare, but not all users have had a seamless onboarding experience, with some owners of the new models reporting that Face ID authentication isn't always working as it should. Posts on social media indicate that certain authentication scenarios like using Face ID to unlock a locked app doesn't always work on the devices.
evidence.title: iPhone 18 Pro Face ID Not Working? Try This

units.text: iPhone 18 Pro Face ID Not Working? Try This

Apple's latest iPhone 18 Pro models came out mid-September to much fanfare, but not all users have had a seamless onboarding experience, with some owners of the new models reporting that Face ID authentication isn't always working as it should.

Posts on social media indicate that certain authentication scenarios like using Face ID to unlock a locked app doesn't always work on the devices. There have also been reports of iPhone 18 Pro models freezing and rebooting when Face ID is activated.

Not only that, MacRumors forum members have reported additional problems, such as receiving a "Face ID is Not Available Message" notification during the authentication setup process. The "Require Attention for Face ID" setting is also said to be not working in some cases.

Fortunately, Apple was listening, and on September 28 the company issued an update for iOS 27 that addresses the Face ID issues. So if you're experiencing similar problems, download iOS 27.0.1. You can do so over the air by going to Settings ➝ General ➝ Software Update.

For the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌, Apple moved the Face ID infrared camera under the display for the first time, but it's unclear if the hardware has been causing a problem. Either way, the update should fix any issues you're having.

evidence.discovery_title: Making millions of iPhone Duos is proving harder than Apple hoped
evidence.raw_lead: Only Apple knows what it expected for yields, but manufacturers are claiming that the iPhone Duo is difficult to manufacture at scale, with its folding screen and hinge complicating production.
evidence.title: Making millions of iPhone Duos is proving harder than Apple hoped

units.text: Only Apple knows what it expected for yields, but manufacturers are claiming that the iPhone Duo is difficult to manufacture at scale, with its folding screen and hinge complicating production.

Assembly yields for the iPhone Duo remain low, while component delays have shortened the time available to refine production. Apple now faces a familiar foldable phone problem: producing millions of units that reliably work.
Foxconn's iPhone Duo assembly yield is just above 60%, according to supply chain sources speaking to Jiemian News. The first production batch is small, and the line still needs repeated adjustments.
One source estimated that yields could take six months to a year to mature under Apple's current standards. How this will affect shipping times remains to be seen, but we expect significant delays.
The sources said the low yield does not stem from a single unresolved technical problem. Equipment, processes, and production settings need refinement as the line moves toward larger volumes.

Samsung Display's OLED panels and hinge components made by other manufacturers have also faced insufficient yields and delayed deliveries. Each upstream delay leaves less time for Foxconn to improve assembly yields.
And, as expected, the very thing that makes the iPhone Duo a duo is responsible for many delays: the hinge.
The hinge contains more than 100 parts working together under tight tolerances. Even relatively small differences can wildly affect how the device functions.

Apple reportedly reconsidered using liquid metal in some hinge parts before mass production, but ultimately decided on a different solution. If it were to revise the process, it would require new prototypes and functional samples, verification, and supplier adjustments.
Historically, Apple has considered manufacturing yields an assembler issue. It's not clear what Apple was expecting for a percentage of devices off the line passing quality inspections.

Apple could, theoretically, relax its standards to allow for more saleable units, but that seems improbable. The supplier could also push its production line harder, though it would likely lead to more units completed, but at a higher percentage of defective units.

Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo as part of its "Surprise and Shine" Apple Event on September 12; it starts at an eye-watering $1,999, before taxes. Apple set October 16 for preorders and October 23 for release, which was notably longer after the initial announcement than even the iPhone X.

evidence.title: Apple releases guide to help families 'build healthy digital habits' - 9to5Mac

units.text: Apple has teamed up with the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) to launch a new guide to “help families create healthy digital habits.”
The new guide follows Apple’s launch of a range of new child safety features in iOS 27.
Apple says this new guide is meant to help families balance screen time with sleep, exercise, schoolwork, and socialization.
The guide includes a six-step breakdown for families, per Apple:
Start a conversation about screen time, with tips for parents to approach the topic and establish expectations in a way that helps kids feel included in the plan.
Create a Child Account, which enables age-based safeguards and gives parents access to parental controls to manage their child’s experience.

evidence.discovery_title: The clever way Apple embedded Face ID beneath the iPhone 18 Pro screen
evidence.raw_lead: In the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has taken one of the next steps toward its long-term vision of the iPhone...
evidence.title: The clever way Apple embedded Face ID beneath the iPhone 18 Pro screen

units.text: In the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has taken one of the next steps toward its long-term vision of the iPhone as a single slab of glass: embedding the Face ID module beneath the display.
Achieving this without having the Face ID array be visible through the display and without compromising the quality of this section of the screen required some clever engineering …

Jony Ive described his long-term vision of the iPhone design as a single slab of glass, and while he is no longer with the company, that goal has remained. Eventually, Apple wants to embed all of the technology requiring screen real estate beneath the display, including both Face ID and front-facing camera.

The iPhone 18 Pro has achieved the first of these, but it was no easy task. Face ID requires infrared light to be both emitted and received by the TrueDepth module – and IR light cannot pass through display pixels.

Apple needed to create gaps between the pixels large enough to allow the IR light to pass between them, but without any visible degradation in the display. To do so, the company’s engineers set out to design a different pixel layout with larger gaps without visibly impacting what can be displayed on those pixels.

iFixit used a microscope to show this pixel pattern, with Apple confirming to me me that the overall pixel density over the module is reduced by half. This would potentially have created a second problem: half the pixel density might have created a visibly dimmer section of the display, so Apple increases the brightness of these pixels to compensate. There also appears to be an IR pass filter to block visible light from passing through the gaps, further hiding the components.

The result is remarkable. For all practical purposes, the TrueDepth camera array is impossible to see even when staring at it extremely closely. I couldn’t capture it even using macro photography with different screen colors and lighting conditions. That’s not to say it’s completely impossible to detect, as iFixit’s microscope view shows, but rather that there is absolutely no way you’ll notice it in everyday use.

Right now, that achievement reduces the size of the Dynamic Island, which in turn enables support for three live activities rather than two. In some future iPhone model, the front-facing camera will also be hidden beneath the display. That’s technically possible today, but the compromise in image quality is currently greater than Apple is willing to accept. Solving that issue is a matter of when rather than if.
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cases
Beats Woven USB-C cables
