evidence.discovery_title: Apple faces renewed scrutiny over removal of ICEBlock from the App Store - 9to5Mac
evidence.raw_lead: CNN reports that Rep. Jamie Raskin sent a letter to Apple this week challenging the company’s explanation for removing ICEBlock from the App Store last year.
evidence.title: Apple faces renewed scrutiny over removal of ICEBlock from the App Store - 9to5Mac

units.text: CNN reports that Rep. Jamie Raskin sent a letter to Apple this week challenging the company’s explanation for removing ICEBlock from the App Store last year. Here are the details.
ICEBlock removal once again under scrutiny

According to CNN, Apple sent a letter to Rep. Jamie Raskin last July explaining its decision to remove ICEBlock and similar apps from the App Store, and Raskin has now responded with new questions about the company’s justification.

For context, ICEBlock was one of the most prominent apps that allowed users to report and track ICE activity in their area. The app rapidly rose in popularity during the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown, growing from around 20,000 users to roughly one million within weeks.

As its popularity skyrocketed, ICEBlock became the target of the US government, with then-Attorney General Pam Bondi publicly calling for Apple to remove the app and warning its developer that he could face prosecution.

Following pressure from the DOJ, Apple removed it and several similar apps from the App Store, citing concerns over the safety of federal agents. The move came shortly after a gunman opened fire on an ICE facility in Dallas, ultimately killing two detainees in an attack that federal authorities described as targeted violence against ICE.

This, in turn, prompted Raskin to investigate whether the Trump administration had pressured Apple and Google into removing ICE-tracking apps, and what impact those removals may have had on constitutionally protected speech.
As part of that investigation, CNN reports that Apple sent Raskin a letter last July explaining why it removed ICEBlock and similar apps from the App Store.
From CNN:

Apple says its decision to remove ICEBlock and similar platforms from the app store last year was prompted by concerns — including those raised by the Trump administration — about agent safety following a fatal shooting that left two detainees dead at a Dallas Immigration and Customs Enforcement office.

Apple’s explanation came in a July letter to Rep. Jamie Raskin, a Maryland Democrat and ranking member of the House Judiciary Committee, who earlier this year launched an investigation into the Justice Department’s role in the removal of the apps from Apple’s and Google’s app stores and the impact on constitutionally protected speech. The letter has not previously been reported.

CNN says that Apple’s letter to Raskin also mentioned that the company approved ICEBlock in April 2025, after developer Joshua Aaron addressed what Apple referred to as “certain user privacy concerns.”

Apple also reportedly said it continued to monitor news coverage and criticism of the app in the months that followed, ultimately deciding to remove ICEBlock and similar apps after concluding they violated its App Store guidelines by providing “precise location information about ICE officers,” which could potentially be used for targeted attacks.
Apple also cited concerns raised by Bondi after the Dallas shooting, as well as comments from FBI Director Kash Patel that the shooter had searched for apps that tracked ICE agents’ locations.
According to Apple, those concerns, together with what it described as a broader increase in ICE activity and threats against agents, prompted the company to conduct a new review of ICEBlock.
Raskin pushes back
According to CNN, Raskin sent a letter to Apple this week further questioning the company’s justification for removing ICEBlock and similar apps from the App Store.
View all comments
From CNN:

Raskin said the move suggests that Apple may be “working with the government to violate its customers’ First Amendment rights to record and report on the activities of their own government” in a response letter sent Monday to Apple’s senior director of government affairs, Timothy Powderly.

CNN also notes that Raskin disputed Apple’s reliance on the Dallas shooting, arguing that the gunman did not need an ICE-tracking app to locate a fixed government facility and reportedly found the address using “an app that comes standard on Apple devices.”

He also pointed to other navigation apps that remain available on the App Store despite providing real-time information about law enforcement locations, and asked Apple to conduct a new independent review of the removals and provide a full list of apps it removed in response to concerns raised by the DOJ.
To read CNN’s full report, follow this link.

evidence.title: AirPods 5 Teardown: Batteries Removable, Case Still Tough

units.text: AirPods 5 Teardown: Batteries Removable, Case Still Tough

Repair site iFixit today took apart Apple's AirPods 5 for one of its traditional teardown videos. It turns out the new AirPods are slightly more repairable than prior models, but it's still not a simple home fix.
We’ve Given AirPods 0/10 for 10 Years. Until Now.iFixit
Watch on YouTube

The ‌AirPods 5‌ use pronged batteries that Apple previously used in the AirPods 3, but not the AirPods 4. The battery can be removed with a "nifty pair of tongs," and iFixit says the component is "intuitive to unplug." When the AirPods 3 used the pronged battery, there was no easy way to get into the earbud, but the ‌AirPods 5‌ are easier to pry open.

iFixit was able get into the ‌AirPods 5‌ with a hair dryer to heat the adhesive and a clamp to hold the earbud in place. The left and right earbuds use different batteries with reversed polarity, so the battery from a left AirPod can't be swapped into a right AirPod, and vice versa.
While the earbuds have a better repair score, iFixit said the case is "still a disaster" and difficult to get into without destroying it.

iFixit gave the ‌AirPods 5‌ a repairability score of 2/10, up from the 0/10 score all previous versions have earned. The site says "skilled technicians and even intrepid DIYers" should be able to replace the AirPods batteries "with a decent success rate."

evidence.discovery_title: More releases, more often will be the Apple way under CEO Ternus
evidence.raw_lead: New CEO John Ternus plans for Apple to speed up product development, with the aim to bring out more products throughout the year instead of a few well-worn events.
evidence.title: More releases, more often will be the Apple way under CEO Ternus

units.text: New CEO John Ternus plans for Apple to speed up product development, with the aim to bring out more products throughout the year instead of a few well-worn events.

Barely a month in the seat, Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing to make big changes to the way the company works. Leaning on his engineering background, he wants Apple to be the same way, working to develop new products at a more rapid rate.

As part of this, Bloomberg reports that Ternus is considering a shake-up to the way that Apple launches products. While everyone is used to the usual fall iPhone events and spring launches, Ternus wants to increase the frequency so it goes throughout the year instead.
Spring and fall launches will probably continue to exist, and will be the focus for the meantime. But expect more introductions at other times of year.

Ternus believes Apple needs to become more experimental and to introduce new products more quickly, unidentified employees told the report. All so that Apple can stay competitive in a market that is so AI-centric.
Employees speaking to the report say that changing such an ingrained development practice will be hard. It's a process that could take years.
Move fast with more things
The change in tempo for releases is only one of the initiatives Ternus wants to embark on, the report continues.
The company is already starting to cut costs, but Ternus also wants to add more sources of revenue.
The primary form of this is to expand the roster of products and services by developing new offerings for consumers. There's also an interest in generating more revenue from existing product users.
Services has been a long-term source of growth for Apple. But, as that starts to slow down, Apple will need to come up with new ideas to keep it from going flat or edging into decline.
In the short term, Apple has set itself up to sell more to consumers in the coming year. Especially when it comes to products going in new directions.

Aside from the usual suspects, there are the AirPods with cameras, as well as the continually rumored launch of Apple Glass. Another big launch will be the eventual launch of the 20th-anniversary iPhone.

evidence.discovery_title: PSA: Do not open links to an early iPhone Duo pre-order page
evidence.raw_lead: Scammers have launched what is claimed to be a pre-order site for the iPhone Duo, but if you are on an older iOS, simply going to the page installs malware.
evidence.title: Do not open links to an early iPhone Duo pre-order page

units.text: Scammers have launched what is claimed to be a pre-order site for the iPhone Duo, but if you are on an older iOS, simply going to the page installs malware.

Genuine iPhone Duo pre-orders start on October 16, 2026, and Apple is now promoting that you can "get ready" from October 12. If you're interested, follow the links on AppleInsider, or go straight to apple.com.

Not to overplay this, if you already have iOS 26 or later, or if you have the latest update to iOS 18, you should be safe. This latest attack appears to use the DarkSword malware, and Apple patched iOS to protect against this in April 2026.
Even so, simply do not go to any "pre-order" site that is sent to you over email, or Messages. Don't even go out of curiosity, because according to Malwarebytes, just opening the page is enough.

The site in question, which of course no one will link to, is reportedly very well designed and looks like an Apple one. It also looks comparatively innocent, since it does not ask for money, it asks users to express interest in pre-ordering.

It even offers a $500 voucher and AppleCare+ coverage for filling out that form. If you've been around Apple long enough, this should alert you because the company would never give a quarter off the retail price of anything.
Then, too, while the iPhone Duo is not yet available, details of it such as the available colors, are well known. This particular scam site lists colors that do not even exist.
How it works
The scam requires users to be on the Safari browser, but it will also take steps to make sure they are. If you were foolish enough to go to the page in any other app, you'd get "Browser Restricted."
On the iPhone, you get that plus it automatically opens Safari for you. DarkSword then attempts to bypass iOS security.

If it succeeds, because the iPhone has not been updated to include Apple's security patch, then the malware goes to work. It sends device details, passwords from the keychain, the contents of Apple Notes, and multiple cryptocurrency wallets.
Then it accesses, or tries to access, call history, voicemails, email, calendar entries, and even location data.
How to stay safe

Again, be sure to update your iPhone's iOS. Under Settings, General, Software Update, tap to install the latest iOS version available for your iPhone. There is also an option for Automatic Updates and you should turn that on, too.

evidence.discovery_title: Apple Explains Why It Removed ICE Tracking Apps Last Year
evidence.raw_lead: In a July 2026 letter addressed to U.S. Representative Jamie Raskin (D-MD), Apple said its decision to remove ICEBlock and similar apps that crowdsourced the real-time locations of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents from the App Store was "prompted by concerns" about "agent safety," according to CNN's Clare Duffy.
evidence.title: Apple Explains Why It Removed ICE Tracking Apps Last Year

units.text: Apple Explains Why It Removed ICE Tracking Apps Last Year

In a July 2026 letter addressed to U.S. Representative Jamie Raskin (D-MD), Apple said its decision to remove ICEBlock and similar apps that crowdsourced the real-time locations of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents from the App Store was "prompted by concerns" about "agent safety," according to CNN's Clare Duffy.

The report said the app removals were "prompted by concerns — including those raised by the Trump administration — about agent safety following a fatal shooting that left two detainees dead at a Dallas Immigration and Customs Enforcement office."

Apple removed ICEBlock from the App Store in October 2025, leading Raskin to launch an investigation into the U.S. Justice Department's apparent role in the removal of the apps from the App Store and Google's Play Store, the report said. Apple's letter responding to Raskin had not previously been reported, according to CNN.
When it removed ICEBlock from the ‌App Store‌, Apple said that the app violated guideline 1.1.1 of its App Review Guidelines:

Information provided to Apple by law enforcement shows that your app violates Guideline 1.1.1 because its purpose is to provide location information about law enforcement officers that can be used to harm such officers individually or as a group. For this reason, your app will be removed from the App Store.
ICEBlock has not returned to the App Store.

units.text: iPhone Duo pre-orders start on Friday, October 16, but Apple just announced when you can get an early start on the process. Here are the details.
Apple will let you ‘Get ready’ for iPhone Duo pre-orders beginning October 12 for fastest checkout
When Apple launches a major new iPhone model, it usually offers a window of time during which you can ‘Get ready’ for the pre-order by making your selections in advance.
The company just confirmed it will do the same for iPhone Duo. Per a new update on Apple’s website, you can begin the iPhone Duo pre-order process as early as Monday, October 12.
Starting October 12, and likely running through much of the day October 15, you’ll be able to go to the Apple Store app or Apple’s online store and make your pre-order selections in advance.
This includes choosing your iPhone Duo color, storage amount, wireless carrier, payment method, and more.
By completing this process ahead of time, Apple says you can get through checkout faster when iPhone Duo pre-orders go live on Friday, October 16 at 8:00 a.m. ET / 5:00 a.m. PT.

If you haven’t done it before, I highly recommend the ‘Get ready’ process to anyone ordering directly from Apple. It’s a great way to minimize potential hiccups on the morning of pre-orders, which means you’ll have a better chance of launch day delivery.
Are you buying an iPhone Duo? Why or why not? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: iPhone Duo pre-orders start on Friday, October 16, but scammers are trying to trick people into visiting a fake website to place their order now.
The website with the malware convincingly replicates the look of the real thing and claims to offer a $500 discount voucher as an “Authorized Partner Exclusive” …

Security researchers at Malwarebytes say the page uses the DarkSword exploit chain, which works with some older unpatched iPhones. You don’t have to do anything, just visiting the page is enough for the attack to launch.

Behind its Apple-style design and $500 voucher, the page uses the leaked DarkSword exploit chain to try to break into vulnerable iPhones. If it succeeds, a separate payload attempts to steal saved credentials, cryptocurrency wallet data, and notes. You don’t have to fill in the form, tap a download, or approve anything. Opening the page is enough to start the attempt.

If it succeeds, then it captures your device identifier information and status and attempts to send a list of installed apps and the contents of your Apple Notes. Having done this, it turns its attention to crypto wallets.

The code looks for cryptocurrency wallets, including MetaMask, Phantom, Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, Exodus, and Tonkeeper. It also attempts to recover saved credentials from the phone’s keychain. If it finds a targeted wallet and the first exchanges with its server succeed, it attempts to upload wallet files, recovered keychain data, and photo thumbnails. Exposure of wallet files or credentials could put funds at risk.
It goes on to try to access messages, contacts, call history, voicemail, email, calendar entries, and cached location data. The payload can also contact its server for further instructions.
The exploit chain was disclosed by Google back in March, with Apple issuing a patch later the same month.
9to5Mac’s Take

The usual advice applies to protect yourself. Never visit links sent to you unless you trust the sender and are specifically expecting them. Always ensure that you install iOS updates as soon as they are available.

units.text: You Can 'Get Ready' for iPhone Duo Pre-Orders on October 12

People who plan to purchase an iPhone Duo can go through the "Get Ready" process starting on Monday, October 12. The new detail was added to the iPhone Duo product page yesterday, according to Reddit.

Get Ready lets users select a preferred color and capacity, confirm their carrier status, choose accessories, choose an AppleCare+ plan, select a trade-in, add a payment method, and set a shipping and billing address.
When pre-orders go live, Get Ready is helpful because it allows for one-tap ordering. It will be especially beneficial for the ‌iPhone Duo‌ because supplies are expected to be limited.
Pre-orders could sell out within minutes given reports of production issues leading to supply constraints, and users who have Get Ready will be able to submit orders faster.
‌iPhone Duo‌ pre-orders will begin on Friday, October 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific Time or 8 a.m. Eastern Time. The device will launch on Friday, October 23. Pricing starts at $1,999.

evidence.title: 苹果 iOS 27.2 Beta 2 系统新改动：控制中心单独设置 App 文字大小滑块回归

units.text: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，据科技媒体 MacObserver 今天报道，部分用户发现苹果 iOS 27.2 Beta 2 测试版系统出现一项改动，此前在控制中心消失的 App 单独设置文字大小滑块已然回归。
IT之家从原报道获悉，用户目前可在 App 内打开控制中心，然后点击 AA 按钮呼出滑块调整应用内文字大小。如果控制中心内没有 AA 按钮，可以通过左上角的加号按钮重新加回去。
该功能允许用户放大或缩小单个 App 的文字大小，不会影响整个系统的大小。用户也可以通过“设置 > 辅助功能 > App 单独设置”针对不同应用设置辅助功能选项，不过操作步骤会更多。

evidence.title: 苹果新CEO启动大改革：精简管理层 加速产品开发

units.text: 知名苹果爆料人马克·古尔曼发文称，苹果新任CEO特努斯上任仅数周，就开始着手对公司进行全面改革。
古尔曼援引知情人士的话称，特努斯已在内部与同事讨论相关计划，这些计划是为了加快产品开发速度、扩大设备产品线，并打造一个更加精简、更加注重工程技术的组织。
古尔曼评论道，这些举措首次展现出，特努斯这位苹果前硬件工程负责人在接替执掌苹果15年的蒂姆·库克后，准备如何重塑这家科技巨头。
知情人士表示，目前正在考虑的初步方案包括降低对传统春季和秋季产品发布节奏的依赖，并取消部分中层管理职位，以减少工程师与高管之间的管理层级。
加速产品开发
知情人士称，特努斯已表示，苹果必须更快推出产品，并采取更多实验性做法，才能在人工智能时代保持竞争力。
与此同时，苹果正在推进削减成本的举措，特努斯还在寻找新的收入来源，以及从现有产品中获得更多收入的方法，尤其是在公司服务业务增长放缓之际。
苹果计划明年推出大量新产品，包括配备摄像头的AirPods、首款智能眼镜，以及为纪念iPhone问世20周年而重新设计的iPhone。
随着新设备密集推出，特努斯正在重新思考产品发布的时间安排。在过去十年中的大部分时间里，苹果主要将重大产品发布安排在秋季，偶尔也会在春季推出新品。
特努斯则希望公司能够更频繁地推出产品，贯穿全年。但有苹果员工表示，改变苹果长期以来形成的产品开发方式并不容易，可能需要数年时间才能完成。
精简管理层
多年来，特努斯一直主张打造更加精简的组织。
在苹果负责硬件工程期间，他曾在一次全员会议上告诉员工，苹果应该减少招聘人数，提高现有工程师的工作产出，并减少组织机构中的冗余。
根据古尔曼的说法，特努斯曾在一次演示中展示了一张苹果员工总数逐年增长的图表，并表示公司应该用更少的员工完成更多工作。
这种理念与Meta、谷歌等硅谷公司的快节奏企业文化相似，目前正逐渐在苹果内部落地。
过去两周，苹果硬件工程部门开始裁撤一些工程项目经理（EPM）。这一职位数十年来一直是苹果产品开发流程的核心，EPM负责管理时间表，并协调不同团队之间的工作。
此次裁员涉及多名项目经理，其中包括大约6名董事级别员工。这是苹果公司内部最高级别的员工职级之一。
这些员工只有几周时间在苹果内部寻找其他职位，无法找到新岗位的人将在今年晚些时候被裁员。
裁员变得频繁
过去，这类裁员在苹果并不常见，但近几个月来已变得越来越频繁。
苹果近期在多个团队实施了一系列规模较小的裁员，同时开始缩减或取消一些仍处于开发早期阶段的项目，尤其是那些被认为对公司盈利贡献较小的项目。
其中包括对苹果Siri数字助手、Vision Pro头显以及人工智能相关软件工程团队进行大幅削减，部分裁员与员工绩效有关。
苹果近期还对Fitness+团队进行了少量裁员。该团队此前正在开发纯音频版本的健身课程。特努斯还在研究如何利用人工智能加快产品开发，并承担目前由人类员工完成的一些工作。
今年夏天，苹果曾制定一项计划，准备裁减约5000名AppleCare客服人员，其中包括大量居家办公员工。公司当时认为，能力不断提升的AI电话和网络客服代理可以接管这些员工部分工作。不过，苹果最终搁置了这一计划，目前也没有准备采取类似措施。
尽管如此，许多员工认为，今年年底或明年年初仍有可能出现进一步裁员。
在多个部门，针对2027年的早期规划会议曾讨论增加预算和员工人数的可能性。但原本计划的预算增幅后来被削减，员工人数则维持同比持平，一些团队则被要求削减营销支出。
古尔曼写道，苹果管理层已经感受到加快工作节奏的压力。一名知情人士表示：“现在几乎所有事情都比过去更加亲力亲为。现在非常忙乱。”
讨论推出新服务
包括该人士在内的多位知情人士都表示，苹果产品开发团队的管理者正被要求在更短的时间内推出更多产品，而且发布频率也要更高。
随着苹果服务业务增长放缓、App Store的商业模式也面临压力。特努斯等人讨论过推出新服务，以及从现有产品和服务中获得更多收入。
长期以来，服务业务一直是苹果增长最快、利润率最高的业务之一，并帮助公司抵消硬件销售波动带来的影响。但该业务的增长势头已经开始减弱。
今年6月所在季度，苹果服务业务收入环比下降，这是自2022年以来首次出现这种情况。尽管如此，该季度服务收入仍高于上年同期，并创下同期历史新高。
对于特努斯及其领导团队而言，加快苹果产品推出节奏可能有助于缓解上述压力，因为这将创造更多销售设备的机会，吸引消费者使用新的服务，并从现有生态系统中获得更多收入。
与此同时，削减成本的行动仍将继续。根据古尔曼的爆料，就连公司即将举行的一系列节日聚会，一些团队也首次被告知，不允许员工携带家属或伴侣参加。

units.text: 部分iPhone 18 Pro用户表示，手机扬声器会发出异常噼啪声、轻微滴答声或随机爆音，相关投诉出现在MacRumors论坛和Reddit。受影响的机型似乎包括iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max，问题多发生在听筒扬声器。
一些用户称杂音持续出现，另一些人则表示，只有在使用应用、浏览网页、收到通知、弹出键盘，或通过蜂窝网络通话时才会听到。在部分设备上，快速开关飞行模式或迅速调整屏幕亮度也可能触发异响。
苹果近日发布iOS 27.0.1，修复Face ID认证失败时可能导致iPhone 18 Pro重启的问题，但更新说明没有提及扬声器故障。用户反馈显示，安装该更新后，杂音仍未消失。还有用户称，更换有问题的手机后，新机仍出现同样情况。

evidence.title: 苹果首款折叠 iPhone Duo 预购倒计时：美国官网 10 月 12 日开放选配置通道

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 今天（9 月 30 日）发布博文，报道称苹果美国官网已宣布将于当地时间 10 月 12 日星期一开放 iPhone Duo 预购窗口，便于用户提前挑选心仪的配置选项。
根据苹果美国官网显示信息，苹果将于 10 月 12 日开放“Get ready”预购准备流程，持续到 10 月 15 日，期间用户可以提前选择机型配置。
苹果正式预购依然为 10 月 16 日，正式发货日期为 10 月 23 日。用户完成预购准备流程后，可以缩短预购开启当天的结账时间。
该媒体认为这一流程有助于减少系统拥堵导致的操作中断，提高用户在首发日当天完成下单的概率。
IT之家查询苹果中国官网，目前暂未发现相关开放预购窗口信息，目前依然显示为北京时间 10 月 16 日晚 8 点接受预购，10 月 23 日发售。

evidence.discovery_title: Apple& American Academy of Pediatrics team up for new Screen Time guide
evidence.raw_lead: Parents are getting guidance on how to establish healthy digital habits for their children and their iPhones and iPads, thanks to a partnership between Apple and the American Academy of Pediatrics.
evidence.title: Apple& American Academy of Pediatrics team up for new Screen Time guide

units.text: Parents are getting guidance on how to establish healthy digital habits for their children and their iPhones and iPads, thanks to a partnership between Apple and the American Academy of Pediatrics.

Back during the WWDC keynote in June, Apple said it will release expanded parental controls in partnership with the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), covering things from content blocking to encouraging healthier browsing habits. Three months later, and more guidance is being provided to parents.

The new guide, a partnership between AAP and Apple, is called "Building Healthy Digital Habits: A Guide for Families." It is an online guide that aims to help parents talk to their children about their electronic device use, and how Apple's devices could be used to bring the guidance into practice.

The guide defines a six-step process, starting with talking to children about screen time, making the children feel included in the conversation. After that, the steps go through setting up a Child Account under Family Sharing, setting up safety settings for websites and apps, scheduling device use, and managing the child's contacts.
The last step is designed to be an ongoing one, namely to "keep the conversation growing as your child grows." As a child's needs evolve, so should any account restrictions.
Part of this information is AAP's screen time guidance by age group, covering infants through to teens.

Apple VP of Health and Fitness, Sumbul Desai, M.D. explains that the AAP guidance and Apple's tools are "designed to adapt to each family and each child's stage of development, giving parents a useful starting point to decide what works best."
The hope is that the guide facilitates discussions and provides resources that are needed to put the guidance into practic3e.
"we know that navigating screens and social media is something every parent wants to get right,"said AAP CEO Mark Del Monte. "This partnership will further support families with those efforts."

evidence.title: Apple Pay Reportedly Launching in India Today

units.text: Apple Pay Reportedly Launching in India Today
Apple Pay is set to launch in India later today (Wednesday local time), starting with Axis Bank credit cards on the Visa and Mastercard networks, according to TechCrunch.

India already has a popular Unified Payments Interface (UPI) system for digital payments, so the initial rollout of Apple Pay in the country is expected to be limited. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and SBI Bank/SBI Card are not expected to support Apple Pay at launch, the report said.

evidence.raw_lead: 原有车辆功能同样得到保留，导航指引和音乐信息仍可显示在仪表盘中，原厂音响、泊车雷达和倒车影像也能继续使用。Boxster 和 Cayman 还有一项额外升级：过去泊车雷达只能发出声音警告，换装新系统后，屏幕还能显示障碍物信息。
evidence.title: 超 30 万辆 2009-2016 款保时捷“老车”焕发第二春，获官方无线苹果 CarPlay 等升级

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，针对旗下的“老车”，保时捷正式推出新一代 PCCM Plus 车机，为超过 30 万辆 2009 至 2016 年款车型补上当代车机功能。
新款 PCCM Plus 适用于 997.2 和 991.1 代 911，以及 987.2、981 代 Boxster 和 Cayman。最受关注的升级，无疑是无线苹果 CarPlay 和 Android Auto。手机可通过蓝牙和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，上车后不用再到处找 USB 线。
新系统采用 7 英寸高分辨率触摸屏，并针对原车电子架构和内饰设计开发，原车配有多功能方向盘的车型也能继续使用方向盘按键。
原有车辆功能同样得到保留，导航指引和音乐信息仍可显示在仪表盘中，原厂音响、泊车雷达和倒车影像也能继续使用。Boxster 和 Cayman 还有一项额外升级：过去泊车雷达只能发出声音警告，换装新系统后，屏幕还能显示障碍物信息。
PCCM Plus 的升级也不只是把手机画面搬到车机上。行车电脑可以显示机油温度和机油压力，导航系统能够显示限速信息和卫星地图影像，Scenic Roads 功能还会专门寻找弯道更多的路线。看来保时捷也知道，有些车主连去哪儿找弯道都需要一点帮助。
IT之家获悉，根据销售市场不同，新系统支持 DAB、HD Radio、FM 和 AM 广播，还能通过蓝牙播放音乐，并显示歌曲名称和歌手信息。nano-SIM 卡槽可接入 4G 网络，地图支持 OTA 更新。部分市场还支持车辆停稳后播放流媒体视频。
保时捷也克制住了把老车内饰彻底“现代化”的冲动。即便装进一辆车龄 10 至 15 年的跑车，新屏幕也不会显得突兀。屏幕中的虚拟保时捷车型甚至可以设置成与车主车辆相同的车身颜色。
PCCM 和 PCCM Plus 后装车机已经推出多年，新一代产品成为迄今功能最丰富的版本，并把这种保留原厂风格的车机升级方案覆盖到更晚年份的当代“老车”。

evidence.discovery_title: Apple Pay now rolling out to Axis Bank customers in India - 9to5Mac
evidence.raw_lead: Nearly twelve years to the day after Apple first announced Apple Pay, the feature is now rolling out in India. Here are the details.
evidence.title: Apple Pay now rolling out to Axis Bank customers in India - 9to5Mac

units.text: Nearly twelve years to the day after Apple first announced Apple Pay, the feature is now rolling out in India, one of the few major markets where it had yet to become available. Here are the details.
Apple Pay finally expanding to India
Earlier today, TechCrunch reported that Apple Pay would launch in India “later Tuesday with Axis Bank as its initial banking partner.”
Now, as spotted by Aaron Perris on X, Apple has begun enabling Apple Pay support in India on its servers, suggesting the rollout is officially underway.
Apple Pay is now rolling out in India after 12 years, as per Apple's backend pic.twitter.com/Takw6hYe7o
— Aaron (@aaronp613) September 30, 2026

According to an Apple support article, there are currently 100 countries and regions that support Apple Pay. India, however, has yet to make the list, which Apple will likely update sooner rather than later.
India has quickly become one of the most strategically important countries for Apple, both in terms of manufacturing and consumer growth.

In addition to expanding its retail presence and repeatedly highlighting strong growth in the country during quarterly earnings calls, Apple and its suppliers have been shifting more iPhone production to India as part of a broader effort to diversify manufacturing beyond China.

That expansion has not been without its controversies. Apple is currently fighting an antitrust case brought by the Competition Commission of India over its App Store practices, and the company has also refused to comply with a government order requiring smartphone makers to preinstall a state-run app on new devices.

Apple manufacturing partner Tata Electronics has also recently come under fire after an Indian pollution regulator alleged that wastewater from one of its iPhone component factories contaminated groundwater and nearby farmland.
Tata was also recently targeted by a cyberattack that allegedly exposed confidential files from several companies, including Apple.
All of that said, Apple’s launch of Apple Pay in India signals another step in the company’s broader expansion in the country and comes at a potentially useful time for its Services business.

During the last fiscal quarter, Apple saw its first sequential drop in Services revenue since fiscal Q4 2022. Of course, India is unlikely to move that needle on its own, but with iPhone sales reaching record levels in the country, Apple Pay gives the company another way to keep building on that momentum.

evidence.discovery_title: 古尔曼：苹果新任 CEO 特努斯着手全面改革，加快产品开发、精简管理层
evidence.raw_lead: 据彭博社马克 · 古尔曼爆料，苹果新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯上任不到一月，已着手调整公司组织与产品开发方式，计划精简层级、加快研发节奏。#苹果人事动态#
evidence.title: 古尔曼：苹果新任 CEO 特努斯着手全面改革，加快产品开发、精简管理层

units.text: IT之家 9 月 29 日消息，彭博社马克 · 古尔曼刚刚报道称，苹果新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）上任不到一个月，便已着手对公司内部展开大刀阔斧的改革。
特努斯希望调整公司组织和产品开发方式，目标包括加快产品研发节奏、扩大硬件产品线，并精简管理层，将更多资源和决策重心放在工程团队上。当然，相关方案目前仍处于内部讨论阶段。
特努斯于 9 月 1 日正式接替蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）出任 CEO，库克则转任董事会执行主席。特努斯此前担任苹果硬件工程高级副总裁，长期负责 Mac、iPhone、AirPods 等产品的硬件开发。
据知情人士透露，特努斯希望减少对传统春秋两次发布会的依赖，让苹果全年更加频繁地推出新品。同时，他还希望削减部分中层管理职位，打破工程师与公司高层之间的间隔。
特努斯曾在负责硬件工程期间向员工表达过类似观点，希望苹果减少人员扩张、让现有工程师承担更多工作，并降低组织结构中的冗余。如今，这种思路开始进一步影响苹果内部的组织调整。
过去两周内，苹果硬件工程部门已经开始裁撤部分工程项目经理（EPM）职位。EPM 长期负责产品开发时间表以及跨团队协调，其中部分被裁职位涉及约 6 名董事级管理人员。这部分员工可在数周时间寻找内部转岗的机会，未能成功转岗的员工将在今年晚些时候离职。
与此同时，苹果近期还在多个部门进行了规模较小的裁员，并提前削减或取消部分处于早期开发阶段、被认为对公司营收贡献有限的项目，涉及 Siri、Vision Pro 以及 AI 软件工程等团队，部分裁员与员工绩效挂钩。另外，苹果 Fitness+ 团队近期也进行了少量人员调整，该团队此前正在开发仅包含音频内容的健身课程。
人工智能也被特努斯视为提高研发效率的重要工具。苹果今年夏季曾制定一项计划，考虑裁减约 5000 名 AppleCare 客服人员，其中包括大量远程办公员工，原因是公司认为改进后的 AI 电话及网页客服已经足以承担部分相关工作。不过，苹果最终暂缓了这一计划，目前并未推进该批裁员。
尽管如此，部分苹果员工预计今年晚些时候或 2027 年初仍可能出现进一步人员调整。面向 2027 年的早期规划会议中，一些部门曾讨论增加预算和员工数量，但部分预算增幅随后被削减，部分团队则被要求维持与上一年度相同的人员规模，同时压缩营销支出。
苹果还面临关键零部件成本上升的压力。古尔曼指出，当前存储芯片价格高涨推高了苹果的采购成本，公司已经通过提高部分产品售价来抵消成本上涨的影响，同时也自行消化了一部分增加的成本。
在产品开发方面，特努斯要求相关管理人员加快推进速度。知情人士表示，目前产品开发团队面临更高的交付要求，需要在更短周期内推出更多产品。苹果原有的研发体系和发布节奏已经运行多年，因此若全面改变，可能需要数年时间。
与此同时，特努斯还与苹果服务业务负责人埃迪 · 库伊（Eddy Cue）、首席财务官凯万 · 帕雷克（Kevan Parekh）讨论新的增收来源，包括推出新的服务，以及提高现有产品和服务的收入贡献。
服务业务长期以来是苹果增长速度较快、利润率较高的业务之一，可以在硬件销售出现波动时提供补充。不过，苹果服务业务的增长动力近期有所减弱。公司 2026 财年第三季度营收达到 1,094 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 7,353.41 亿元人民币），同比增长 16%，其中服务业务仍创下同期营收纪录。
特努斯上任后的产品规划也相当密集。苹果预计将在 2027 年推出包括配备摄像头的 AirPods、首款智能眼镜以及为纪念 iPhone 诞生 20 周年而重新设计的 iPhone 等多款新产品。
如果苹果进一步提高产品发布频率，公司将获得更多销售硬件、推动用户使用新服务以及提高现有生态系统收入的机会。不过，目前相关组织改革和产品节奏调整仍处于推进阶段，苹果尚未公开确认具体方案。

evidence.discovery_title: OpenAI进军身份验证市场 推出“用ChatGPT一键登录”功能 - AI 人工智能 - cnBeta.COM
evidence.raw_lead: 随着人工智能工具深度嵌入互联网日常应用，OpenAI正依托其庞大的用户基数开辟全新业务版图。该公司日前正式推出“使用ChatGPT登录”（SigninwithChatGPT）身份验证服务，允许第三方开发者和企业将ChatGPT账号作为其应用的统一认证入口。这一举措标志着OpenAI正式涉足数字身份验证领域，直接与长期主导这一市场的Google、苹果及微软等科技巨头展开正面竞争。
evidence.title: OpenAI进军身份验证市场 推出“用ChatGPT一键登录”功能 - AI 人工智能 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 随着人工智能工具深度嵌入互联网日常应用，OpenAI正依托其庞大的用户基数开辟全新业务版图。该公司日前正式推出“使用ChatGPT登录”（Sign in with ChatGPT）身份验证服务，允许第三方开发者和企业将ChatGPT账号作为其应用的统一认证入口。这一举措标志着OpenAI正式涉足数字身份验证领域，直接与长期主导这一市场的Google、苹果及微软等科技巨头展开正面竞争。

在现代互联网架构中，诸如“通过Google登录”或“通过苹果登录”等单点登录方案已被广泛采用，不仅简化了用户注册繁琐表单的流程，也为平台方构筑了深厚的用户生态壁垒与持续的黏性支撑。业界分析指出，ChatGPT在极短时间内积累了数以亿计的活跃用户，为其演变为通用网络身份凭证奠定了坚实的基础设施底座。OpenAI此番推出专属登录系统，意在将自身从单一的AI对话平台，进一步升级为互联网底层的关键身份枢纽与生态入口。
该机制在技术层面主要依托业界通行的安全认证协议搭建。第三方服务集成该接口后，用户即可在无需重复创建独立密码的前提下安全授权登录。对于开发者而言，引入ChatGPT认证能够降低用户流失率并简化身份管理；而对OpenAI而言，这一服务能够更广泛地将其技术与品牌嵌入数以万计的第三方网站、企业协作工具及外部开发应用中，拓展其作为底层账户提供商的控制力。
不过，业内人士也对该功能的普及路径表达了审慎态度。相比于老牌科技巨头经过多年验证的企业级身份管理与严格合规框架，新兴AI平台作为主身份供应商在数据隐私保护、账户安全防御以及服务高可用性方面仍需面临严格的市场检验。此外，在企业级单点登录体系中，组织对数据主权和内部访问权限控制具有严苛要求，如何让企业信任并采纳基于AI平台的认证体系，将是OpenAI面临的核心考验。

evidence.title: Meta旗下AI智能体Muse被曝越权读取苹果信息应用数十万条数据 - AI 人工智能 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: Meta近期推出的全新人工智能智能体“Muse”陷入严重隐私侵犯争议。相关测试发现，该AI工具在未获得用户明确授权、甚至在相关权限被明确禁用的情况下，擅自读取并同步了苹果设备系统级“信息”（Messages）数据库中的大量聊天记录。
Muse是Meta重点推广的一款AI智能体，旨在协助用户进行资料检索、生成简报及辅助购物。Meta官方宣称，该系统运行在专用虚拟计算机上，能够连接各类应用和数据源以提供定制化交互，并公开承诺会严格遵守用户设定的系统权限，绝不会访问未经授权的数据。然而，Meta在产品说明文档中亦保留了免责表述，称该智能体可能出现失误或采取“意料之外的操作”。

科技媒体专栏作者杰森·阿滕（Jason Aten）在其实际测试中发现了严重的越权行为。阿滕在iPhone及用于评估AI工具的Mac mini上安装了Muse。仅在安装一天后，Muse便根据他此前通过短信与播客搭档讨论的私人对话内容，主动向其推荐文章选题。面对询问，Muse最初声称相关信息源自弹出的来电或短信通知横幅。但后续的技术排查显示，在系统未授予“完全磁盘访问权限”（Full Disk Access）、且明确未获短信读取许可的情况下，Muse已擅自同步并抓取了本地苹果信息数据库中多达18.7万行文本记录并上传至云端。
这一异常情况表明，Muse并非仅仅截获了Meta旗下的Messenger对话，而是绕过系统限制强行提取了苹果设备原生的短信与iMessage历史数据。在短短24小时内同步数十万行数据，意味着该程序完整读取了设备过去累积的所有历史聊天档案。

外界分析指出，该事件反映出科技巨头在推进生成式AI时正在引发更深层次的隐私危机。此前，Meta曾因要求用户授权全量上传相册照片以“生成发帖灵感”而广受诟病，其智能眼镜产品也频现隐私侵权风险。此次Muse的行为进一步暴露出，在缺乏有效技术围栏与监管的前提下，AI系统对个人隐私数据的汲取已近乎失控，即便普通用户选择不主动使用该类产品，其与安装该软件的联系人之间的私密往来也存在被动泄露的风险。目前，Meta尚未就Muse如何绕过系统底层权限读取第三方数据作出合理解释。

units.text: iPhone Duo Reportedly Facing Production Problems Ahead of Launch
The iPhone Duo is reportedly facing production difficulties ahead of its October launch, with early output expected to be limited.

A person said to be close to Foxconn's supply chain told China's Jiemian News that final assembly yields for Apple's first foldable iPhone were only slightly above 60% as of September 17. The source said that, under Apple's current quality standards, it could take another six months to a year for the assembly line to reach a mature yield.

According to the source, Foxconn is repeatedly adjusting equipment, assembly processes, and production settings as it makes the ‌iPhone Duo‌ at scale. The source also said suppliers were waiting to see whether Apple would ease any quality requirements to accelerate production.

The problems apparently extend beyond final assembly. Jiemian News said Samsung Display's foldable OLED panels and hinge components had experienced low yields, delayed deliveries, and design changes. Delays in those parts leave the assembler less time to tune its production line.

The publication added that Apple tested Liquid Metal for some hinge parts before reassessing the approach ahead of mass production. Apple says its hinge contains more than 100 components and has a 3D-printed cover.

A supply chain source also told Jiemian News that Apple's global stocking target for the ‌iPhone Duo‌ in 2026 is approximately six million to eight million units. The publication compared that figure with typical shipments of 20 million to 30 million units over a full product cycle for an individual iPhone Pro or Pro Max model. A separate retail source said Apple's sales guidance exceeds five million units.

In another report, MyDrivers claims that one of the device's contract manufacturers asked Apple to choose between prioritizing yield and increasing output. The site suggested that running the production line harder could produce more saleable phones, but with the side-effect of more defective units and higher scrap costs.
Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo on September 9. Pre-orders are scheduled to begin October 16, with availability following on October 23. The ‌iPhone Duo‌ starts at $1,999 in the United States.

Apple reportedly plans to debut its long-awaited smart home hub device, a new HomePod mini , and a new Apple TV . The new ‌HomePod mini‌ and ‌Apple TV‌ are set to retain their existing designs, but tout faster chips to support Siri AI. The new ‌HomePod mini‌ will also come in new color options, including pink and green. All three products are set to showcase ‌Siri‌ AI, which apparently explains the delay in their launch. All three were originally planned to launch in 2024. Apple plans to update the larger HomePod at a later date. A privacy-focused home security camera and sensor is also in the works; the device can detect which room a person is in and does not record video. Apple also continues to work on a higher-end version of the smart home hub, featuring a 9-inch display mounted on a robotic arm that can swivel 360 degrees. evidence.title: 消息称苹果计划削减5000个AppleCare岗位 AI将改造客服业务 - Apple 苹果 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 苹果近期被曝曾计划在AppleCare支持业务中裁减约5000个岗位，这一规模相当于该业务员工总数的较大比例。相关调整被认为是苹果新任CEO约翰·特努斯上任后，公司推动组织精简、降低成本以及提高运营效率的一部分。
据报道，苹果此前已经向部分AppleCare员工提供离职方案，并在今年夏季和秋季持续推进相关人员调整。此次计划涉及的岗位主要集中在AppleCare和Apple Support业务，也就是负责处理用户技术支持、设备维修以及其他售后问题的团队。
苹果目前尚未公开确认5000人裁员计划的具体规模，也没有宣布一项面向AppleCare业务的统一大规模裁员计划。不过，近期已经出现多起与Apple Support和AppleCare员工有关的离职案例。部分员工在休假期间也被管理人员联系并提供离职方案，其中包括处于医疗、产假、育儿假、军人假以及家庭暴力相关休假状态的员工。一家美国就业法律机构此前已经针对这些员工被提供离职方案的情况展开调查。
如果5000人的裁员计划最终全面实施，将成为苹果近年来规模较大的人员调整之一。苹果过去很少进行大规模裁员，即使在2023年科技行业普遍裁员期间，苹果也主要通过冻结招聘、自然减员以及对部分团队进行重组来控制人员规模，而不是像其他大型科技公司那样进行大规模集中裁员。
此次AppleCare业务调整发生在苹果整体组织结构开始发生变化的背景下。约翰·特努斯于2026年9月1日正式接替Tim Cook出任苹果CEO，此后苹果正在考虑更加明显地精简管理层级，并进一步强化工程团队在公司决策中的地位。近期报道称，特努斯正在推动一项更大范围的组织调整，希望让工程师与高级管理层之间的沟通更加直接，同时减少部分中层管理岗位。
苹果近期已经出现了一些其他业务线的裁员迹象。8月底，苹果在美国湾区裁减了约147名员工，其中部分岗位涉及Vision Pro和Siri项目。9月，Apple Fitness+也被曝裁减少量员工，相关团队内部认为这可能是该服务进一步削减成本和调整业务方向的前兆。
AppleCare本身是苹果售后服务体系的重要组成部分。除了传统的电话和在线技术支持之外，AppleCare还涉及维修服务、意外损坏保障以及AppleCare+等付费服务。随着苹果不断扩大AppleCare订阅业务，该部门不仅承担客户支持职能，也已经成为苹果服务业务的一部分。
苹果近年来也在不断调整AppleCare的商业模式。今年7月，苹果提高了部分Mac和iPad AppleCare+订阅计划的价格，美国市场的月付方案上涨0.5美元，年付方案上涨5美元。与此同时，苹果继续推广AppleCare One，并在9月推出面向家庭用户的AppleCare One Family方案，可以覆盖家庭共享组中最多6人的符合条件设备。
因此，如果苹果确实进一步减少AppleCare一线支持人员，未来很可能需要通过自动化、人工智能以及更加集中化的客服系统来承担部分原本由人工客服完成的工作。苹果近年来一直在扩大人工智能技术的应用范围，而新一代Siri以及相关AI服务也正在逐步推进。不过，目前没有证据表明这5000个岗位全部是因为人工智能取代人工客服而被取消。
与此同时，苹果整体员工规模依然庞大。公司此前并没有公布一项类似微软、亚马逊等科技巨头那样的大规模全公司裁员计划，因此目前更准确的说法是，苹果正在针对特定业务和组织层级进行人员优化，而AppleCare可能成为此次调整中规模最大的业务之一。
如果5000个岗位最终被取消，这也将显示特努斯执掌苹果后的管理思路正在逐渐显现。与库克时代长期保持相对稳定的组织结构相比，新管理层正在同时面对人工智能投入增加、硬件成本上涨以及新产品研发需求扩大等压力，并试图通过精简组织和调整现有业务来释放更多资源。AppleCare的大规模岗位调整目前仍处于报道和计划阶段，最终裁员人数以及具体实施方式仍可能发生变化。

evidence.title: 苹果首款折叠屏iPhone据报量产不足 上市初期供应或将有限 - Apple iPhone - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo据报在计划于10月上市前遭遇生产困难，上市初期的产量可能较为有限。接近富士康供应链的消息人士向中国《界面新闻》透露，截至9月17日，最终组装良率仅略高于60%。按照苹果目前的质量标准，生产线可能还需要6个月至一年才能达到成熟良率。
消息人士称，富士康正在反复调整设备、组装流程和生产参数，以扩大iPhone Duo产能。供应商则在观望苹果是否会放宽部分质量要求，以加快生产。问题也不只出在最终组装环节。《界面新闻》报道称，三星显示提供的折叠OLED面板及铰链组件曾出现良率偏低、交付延迟和设计调整等情况，零部件延误进一步压缩了组装厂调试生产线的时间。
苹果曾在部分铰链组件上测试液态金属，但在量产前重新评估了这一方案。苹果表示，iPhone Duo的铰链包含100多个零部件，并采用3D打印外盖。
一名供应链人士透露，苹果为iPhone Duo设定的2026年全球备货目标约为600万至800万台。报道将这一数字与单款iPhone Pro或Pro Max机型整个产品周期通常出货2000万至3000万台相比较。另有零售渠道人士称，苹果对该机的销售指引超过500万台。
另一篇来自MyDrivers的报道则称，一家代工厂曾要求苹果在优先提高良率与扩大产量之间作出选择。加快生产线运行可以增加可销售手机数量，但也可能带来更多瑕疵品，并推高报废成本。
苹果已于9月9日发布iPhone Duo，计划于10月16日开启预购，10月23日正式开售；美国起售价为1999美元。

evidence.raw_lead: 科技媒体 macobserver 昨日（9 月 29 日）发布博文，报道称由于谷歌 Firebase 的突发故障，导致数千款 iOS 应用启动后立即崩溃，部分应用的崩溃次数较日均水平高出 5000 倍。
evidence.title: 已修复：谷歌 Firebase 突发故障致数千款 iOS App 崩溃，部分频率较日常高 5000 倍

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，科技媒体 macobserver 昨日（9 月 29 日）发布博文，报道称由于谷歌 Firebase 的突发故障，导致数千款 iOS 应用启动后立即崩溃，部分应用的崩溃次数较日均水平高出 5000 倍。
IT之家注：Firebase 是谷歌提供的云服务平台，面向移动应用和网页应用提供数据库、身份验证、消息推送、崩溃报告与数据分析等功能。开发者可通过软件开发工具包接入相关服务，用于登录、统计用户行为和监测应用稳定性。
报道指出程序员发现其应用启动后便崩溃，随后在社区发布排查信息，部分开发者一度误以为自身代码出现故障。随着报告增加，社区用户发现问题根源指向谷歌的 Firebase 服务。部分应用记录的崩溃次数，较平日平均水平高出 5000 倍。

units.text: DoorDash today launched a new way to order your next meal: via text in Apple’s Messages app, powered by AI. Here are the details.
DoorDash text ordering launches on iPhone, powered by AI agent

AI agents are here to stay, and they don’t just look like cute digital creatures. While Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots have gotten a lot of attention, AI agents are popping up in ways that are less obviously “AI” too.

For example, today DoorDash launched the ability to skip the app and simply text to place your food order in Apple’s Messages app. It’s available in the US only to start, and interested users will need to first join this waitlist. And it’s all powered by an AI agent.
Here’s the rundown on how it works, via DoorDash’s announcement:
Text what you’re craving: Ask for a specific dish, request a local recommendation based on your mood, or simply reorder your go-to Friday night meal for the family.

Skip the search: DoorDash searches local spots, scans menus, and suggests a cart based on what you’re in the mood for. It even texts you photos of the food it recommends right from the restaurant’s store page on the DoorDash app.

Truly personalized ordering: Text “order my usual” and it knows you mean your Friday night order — no need to spell out the dish, the modifiers, or the restaurant. It already knows whether you skip cilantro, always add extra sauce, or never miss dessert. The more you order, the more it learns, and if you want, it can message you proactively to ask if you want your usual coffee order based on your daily habits.

Manage group preferences with ease: Ordering for large groups is never easy, especially when everyone wants something different. It can handle mixed dietary preferences and different quantities in one order, so you’re not the one juggling everyone’s requests.
Checkout without ever opening the app: Confirm your order right inside the text thread and it manages checkout.
To get started, join DoorDash’s waitlist and you’ll be notified when text access is granted. Depending on demand, that access might arrive right away, or it may take some time.
Are you interested in using DoorDash’s AI agent to order via Apple’s Messages app? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: I'm in the bag for iPhone Duo, but I wanted to test out an iPhone 18 Pro Max camera system before going all in on Apple's foldable. Here's what I learned as I prepare for a potential camera downgrade.

I would love nothing more than to travel to some remote part of the planet and detail exactly how iPhone 18 Pro Max performs while showing off incredible one-of-a-kind photos. That isn't what I'm here to do today.
My simple goal is to explain exactly what I have observed about Apple's latest camera system, coming from the iPhone 17 Pro Max, and what buying an iPhone Duo might mean losing out on.
The iPhone 18 Pro Max showcases exactly what makes Apple's smartphone camera such a well-balanced and all-around great camera system. It's yet another pinnacle in years of slight improvements.
Photos captured on both iPhones are in the Bright Photographic Style at about -40 tone and +38 color.
Point and shoot

I've got my trusty Sony a7II from 2014 that continues to produce amazing results straight from the sensor, RAW or not. I always shoot full manual with that camera and have no interest in the automatic settings.

So, it might be odd to say that I behave exactly the opposite on iPhone. For years, I downloaded the pro-level camera apps, tinkered with my workflow, edited every image to death — it was a tad exhausting at times.
There had to be a better way.
I wanted more control and a more unique look to my photos than what capturing straight from the iPhone camera could give me. Editing and filters often felt overprocessed and unrealistic.
I wanted to capture photos quickly and easily without fiddling with all those little digital dials and settings. I also wanted a workflow that was non-destructive and easily changed later.
Photographic Styles bring non-destructive customization to every photo
Apple gave me exactly what I wanted with Photographic Styles. The fully-reversible non-destructive shooting modes that could be preset and forget transformed how I approached mobile photography.
My big camera still sits at full manual and offers me control when I want it. My iPhone, on the other hand, is basically full auto with custom Photographic Styles.
I stopped shooting Apple ProRAW except in circumstances where I specifically knew I'd like more editing control. Photographic Styles are just that good.

The issue has never been about a lack of control, as that could be solved with third-party apps, it's the lack of physical controls. Apple tried to solve this with the poorly-executed Camera Control, which ends up being too fiddly as anything more than a shutter button.
Camera Control didn't get any of the new pro controls on iPhone 18 Pro Max
Apple is already showing signs of being done with Camera Control — the new pro camera tools aren't even part of it. I expect it'll be gone in a generation or two.

I'd love to see Apple make a physical camera with knobs and dials for each minute setting, but that isn't going to happen. The iPhone is inherently a point-and-shoot experience, and I'm okay with that.

I'll never complain about having more options for precise control, but they're going to be used as an exception to the norm. Nearly every photo captured will be done with the press of a shutter and nothing else.
That's the beauty of Photographic Styles. Take the photos you want now at whatever preset you've chosen and change them later as needed.

I like a camera that I can point and click the shutter, even my Sony a7II can function that way thanks to a back-button focus I have set up. I adjust the dials when needed, but most of the time I can set them and just capture photos until conditions change.
iPhone and Photographic Styles lets me do the same, if not even more efficiently. iPhone 18 Pro Max, however, is a step in the opposite direction in some cases.
Variable aperture is just fine, actually
Apple's approach to variable aperture is likely one of necessity. The iPhone 18 Pro Max Main Fusion camera is f/1.48 fully open.
Variable aperture only gets you so much control on a sensor that small
The problem is, until now, all iPhones shot photos fully open. There wasn't a physical aperture to close and let in less light.

Previous recent models shot at around f/1.78, which produced a soft bokeh when close enough to the subject. The subject was still sharp while plenty of light was gathered — it was the perfect set point for something that couldn't be changed.
Then arrives the f/1.48 sensor. It's "better" in that it can let in more light, meaning faster shutter speeds and better ISO (less noise).
The problem is you definitely do not want to shoot at that level all the time. With this sensor, f/1.48 is at the edge of beginning to lose sharpness in the subject.

The iPhone 18 Pro Max will default to f/1.8 for most shots and automatically switch to f/1.48 in low-light settings. The f/2.8 setting is a bit sharper even if it lets in less light, while f/4.0 is the max and loses sharpness again.

You'll use f/4.0 in the brightest of settings to ensure all faces are in focus in a cluster of people, for example. It's also great in dimmer or complex lighting environments where the aperture creates a "star" wherever pinpoints of light are visible.

The star looks best at f/2.8 in my opinion, but some may not like them at all, as they are technically a flaw in the photo being captured. The star results from how bright light is shown on the sensor through the aperture blades.
iPhone 18 Pro Max has a sun star effect when the aperture is anything other than full open
I appreciate this level of control in my iPhone camera. That said, it does feel a bit fiddly.

I expect the friction and fiddly nature of variable aperture on iPhone will ultimately result in me relying on the automatic setting. I'm enthusiastic about it now in my testing, but I'm certain I'd only rarely choose to change that toggle.
The smallest of gains

After variable aperture, the first thing you'll notice in a one-to-one comparison is how Photographic Styles has changed. It appears Apple has tweaked the pipeline and application values that result in slightly different, more refined looks versus the previous version.
Variable aperture isn't a reason to jump ship from iPhone 17 Pro Max

Upon further investigation, there is also a difference in how the iPhone deals with white balance. There is a pro tool for choosing white balance compensation on iPhone 18 Pro Max, but it's set to auto by default.
Whatever has changed with white balance behavior is noticeable in some light. It sometimes feels like an overcorrection, which is why you might want to use the manual control.
The available pro tools are great to have in the Apple Camera app. Shutter speed is something I love being able to control, as that is how you can get light trails in some situations.

Third-party apps can control these aspects of the iPhone camera, so that's not exactly new. It's a little weird that Apple doesn't include the pro camera controls in iPhone Duo or other non-pro iPhones.

I think third-party apps will be the better place to control these aspects of iPhone photography. The only reason you might use the Camera app to control these aspects is if you still want access to Apple's full camera pipeline.
Pro camera controls are exclusive to iPhone 18 Pro models
Minus the pro camera controls I mentioned, all of this is coming to iPhone Duo. The new Photographic Styles, updated processing, and white balance differences will be present in Apple's foldable.
In my previous camera spec breakdown, I found that the two most notable differences between iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo will be the existence of an optical telephoto camera and variable aperture.

Nearly every other aspect is identical, which means iPhone Duo users shouldn't be worried about having a "worse" camera experience. Funny enough, for me at least, there may not be that much difference.
What is gained, what will be lost
Like everyone else, I won't have an iPhone Duo to test until October 23, so that aspect will have to wait for another day. For now, I can only address what I've learned about iPhone 18 Pro Max.
Specs suggest iPhone Duo will have great cameras
I wish I had more time with the iPhone 18 Pro Max, and I'm perfectly aware of my limited time, so take what I have to say here with that in mind.
From what I can tell without holding an iPhone Duo in hand, I believe my previous conclusion stands true: optical telephoto and variable aperture are all I'll miss on iPhone Duo.
What I gain will be a foldable with new camera abilities like Smart Take and Duo FaceTime. Whether or not that's an equivalent exchange will be determined at a later date.

Like with Apple Watch Ultra, I believe a lot of iPhone "Pro" features fall into aspirational purchase territory. It's not that I don't consider myself a "professional" photographer, or find iPhone's pro controls too unwieldy, just that they're unnecessary for most applications.

The variable aperture on iPhone 18 Pro Max doesn't have enough range to capture photos like the fountain example above. The water looks like that on the Sony a7II because I could set the aperture to f/22 and allow very little light in during a longer exposure.

When I use my Sony a7II camera, I'm using it the same way a professional might by taking control of every aspect of each photo using the device's physical controls. The interface and physicality of that camera leans into it being used as a professional tool.

When I shoot photos with my iPhone, I'm just pressing the shutter and letting the device do the rest. Photographic Styles give me enough control to ensure every photo I capture is uniquely mine, so I don't feel the need to dive deeper into the settings.
Too much control can lead to you missing the shot

Photographic Styles 3 with texture and grain options is available on iPhone Duo. Apple is not including pro controls, so no manual white balance, shutter speed, or access to a histogram will be available.
Here's the thing, I don't know that I'll even notice or care. If I need control over those things, I can access them in third-party apps.
Sometimes you just need to take the damn photo
When I was testing iPhone 18 Pro Max as a camera, I noticed how much time I spent in menus selecting each little tool set point. I would take a couple of shots, then back to those menus.
iPhones make great cameras because they're the one you have on you
The more photos I shot, the less time I spent adjusting anything manually. It was just too time-consuming to adjust aperture manually for each shot or worry about shutter speed.
As I've always inevitably learned with the iPhone, it is better to just point and shoot. If I want to have more control for a specific shot, there are third-party apps or Apple's controls available.
Thanks to that mentality, it means my photo-shooting experience will be very similar on iPhone Duo. Even the variable aperture fades to the background since most photos are taken at f/1.8.
iPhone Duo will capture all photos at f/1.78.
An iPhone couldn't take this photo
The iPhone 18 Pro Max is Apple's best camera system yet. It has the most options for manual control, includes an interesting variable aperture, and has the best image pipeline so far.

That variable aperture is interesting, and in a generation or two, it'll be so good it'll be hard to miss. Today, the gains provided by it are minimal, and only a good eye will spot the difference in most shots.
If you're anything like me, there won't be much to miss when choosing the iPhone Duo. It is still an iPhone camera system, and a powerful one at that with A20 Pro and Photographic Styles 3.
I have no doubt that future Apple foldables will have pro-level camera systems. Today, iPhone Duo doesn't, which makes it a primary purchase decision between the two devices.
This write up was for the photography nerds like me. Most iPhone users won't be able to spot the difference between shots on an iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro without being told what to look for.
That Charmander figure is softer and less defined here thanks to the iPhone's f/1.48 wide open aperture.
It's a big leap in performance and function, don't get me wrong. However, even the big leaps only show through so much on an already amazing camera system.

For those just wondering how it compares with previous iPhone cameras, think of it this way: your iPhone is already the best camera you own. The only differences an upgrade will bring is better experiences at the fringes.

You'll always capture pristine and beautiful photos in broad daylight. Dim and night photos will prove a challenge to even the best smartphone cameras, but Apple's latest systems perform marginally better over previous ones.
iPhone 18 Pro Max gives photographers more control than ever
iPhone 18 Pro Max is about control. However, I'm increasingly wondering how much control we actually need when the cameras are this good.

I'm glad the options are there, first or third-party, but it just goes to show how good the iPhone has become as a camera that the controls are almost unnecessary. I'm aware that these thoughts might reflect my own journey as a photographer more than what is true of Apple's offering, so your miles may vary.
The thing is, I don't feel this way about my dedicated camera. It's more akin to using a record player — deliberate and thoughtful.

When I pull out my Sony camera, I'm setting out on a photographic journey to accomplish a shot I'm envisioning using the controls in my hands. When I pull out my iPhone, I'm looking to capture a moment or a memory in an instant.
I matched the Sony's settings with the result from the iPhone, which produced a dimmer shot. That's mostly due to the exposure stacking iPhone performs with every shot.

Each of these devices serves different purposes and reaches different goals. When photographing people, the big camera draws attention, for better or for worse, and changes the environment you're photographing by the nature of the device.

The iPhone can show up and not draw anyone's eye, though I'm sure that'll be an issue for the iPhone Duo for a time. In any case, there's something more fleeting and unserious about capturing an iPhone photo.
Into the corn maze

I'm over 2.3k words into this, so I'll keep this bit short. I spent a day at a pumpkin patch with my friends recently and had three cameras on my person — iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and Sony a7II.
A still frame of the spatial video captured on iPhone 18 Pro Max

I took about 80 keepable photos and some video during the day, with about 39 on my Sony a7II. The sun was too bright and over-exposing everything, so it was a challenging shooting day for full-manual controls.

Nearly every other photo was taken on the iPhone 17 Pro Max, and zero with the telephoto camera. I wanted to reserve the iPhone 18 Pro Max, deliberately, for situations I thought called for that specific device.
None arose, though I did capture a spatial video in the corn maze with it.

There are a few photos I really like from the iPhone, as they captured casual situations more easily. A few exemplified the speed at which I could get a photo when using an iPhone versus a larger camera.
I snuck a few photos with the iPhone 17 Pro Max while recording video with the iPhone 18 Pro Max
Nearly all of my favorite shots came from the Sony a7II. Not just because it is a superior full-frame camera with a powerful lens, but because they felt more deliberate.

I took the time to compensate for lighting whether we were in the sun or shade, using the easy-to-use controls on the camera. Adjusting these things on the fly was intuitive and simple compared to the digital touch interface of an iPhone.

Some shots were a bit out of focus or had motion blurring where the iPhone wouldn't have allowed it. However, there's something I can't quite put my finger on that separates the "quality" of the two images.
Of course, no smartphone can truly compete with a full-frame camera. There is a reason professionals still buy them over simply shooting with an iPhone for everything.
iPhone 18 Pro Max is incredible in spite of its small camera sensors

That's the point I'm reaching for, though I'm not sure I'm conveying it well. Apple wants iPhone 18 Pro Max to reflect the performance and control of a high-end full-frame camera, but falls short due to a lack of dedicated physical controls and sensor size.
Physics will always win in this contest. There isn't space for good physical camera controls on iPhone, nor is there room for larger sensors.
My point is, pros will always choose the bigger camera when possible. However, the power of the iPhone is that it is always on your person, therefore winning as the best camera for that reason.

Though, because of the physical limitations of a smartphone, I think it makes more sense to lean into automatic settings and systems like Photographic Styles. It's great more control is available to those that need it, but very few people will.
iPhone accessories never quite recreate the dedicated camera experience
I wouldn't mind seeing more accessories for iPhone that bring pro-level physical controls to iPhone. Apple should build more APIs to allow that, but that's a conversation for another day.

To bring this thing to a close, I'll share this: iPhone 18 Pro Max is amazing, and in some ways, better even than the iPhone 17 Pro Max I still possess. However, iPhone cameras have gotten so good that simply getting the shot and worrying about the details later is the way to go in 99% of situations.

The iPhone Duo will get Photographic Styles 3 with texture and grain control, so I'll dive more into that when I'm testing the foldable. I can already tell that I'll love grain when it is warranted, but it can be too aggressive at times.
Smart Take and Kid Cue are features exclusive to iPhone Duo
I'm glad I took the time to test out the iPhone 18 Pro Max cameras myself. I can now say quite confidently that even as good as the upgrades are, they're ones I can and will live without.
Next up, iPhone Duo as a camera. If my assumptions are right, the only thing I will truly miss is the optical telephoto 4x camera and the lack of spatial video capture support.
I have zero doubt iPhone Duo will capture photos just as good as iPhone 18 Pro Max in most day-to-day situations. I'll share those experiences later in October.

evidence.discovery_title: Variable aperture iPhone 18 Pro now supported by Final Cut Camera
evidence.raw_lead: The latest update to Final Cut Camera for iOS can take advantage of the iPhone 18 Pro variable aperture system, giving video professionals more control over the shot.
evidence.title: Variable aperture iPhone 18 Pro now supported by Final Cut Camera

units.text: The latest update to Final Cut Camera for iOS can take advantage of the iPhone 18 Pro variable aperture system, giving video professionals more control over the shot.

Final Cut Camera is a companion app for Final Cut Pro for iPad, enabling users to capture live multi-camera projects with a collection of iPhones, as well as for more conventional filming purposes. In an update rolling out on Tuesday, the app is being upgraded with new features.

The big and timely change is variable aperture support for the new Fusion Main camera in the iPhone 18 Pro. Final Cut Camera can now select one of the available apertures from f1.48 to F4, with users also able to choose shutter or aperture priority modes, when recording video.
There's also Cinematic mode effects for other video recordings, including those recorded in ProRes and Apple Log.

The update also introduces support for video scopes,, including the RGB parade and histogram. False color and clipping indicators with threshold settings are also available for dialing in the exposure.
Professional shooters can also get a clean video signal for broadcast-quality streams using an HDMI-to-SDI converter.

There's also the capability to set a genlock frame delay, so that you can compensate for image artifacts from a record display. More usefully, this can also help deal with latency differences with other genlocked cameras.
The update to Final Cut Camera is free, as is the app, and requires iOS 26.66 or later.

units.text: iFixit’s teardown of the new AirPods 5 is now up, revealing an important, albeit tiny, repairability improvement. Watch it below.
Record repairability score at 2/10

Since Apple launched the original AirPods in 2016, iFixit has consistently given them a 0 out of 10 for repairability. From heavily glued-in batteries and soldered connections to housings that are nearly impossible to open and reassemble without damage, AirPods have always been notoriously difficult to repair.

With the new AirPods 5, however, iFixit says Apple has taken a tiny step in the right direction, provided the repair is being done by a skilled professional or particularly adventurous DIY enthusiast.

In their new teardown video, iFixit shows that the batteries inside each earbud can be removed and replaced without necessarily destroying the AirPods in the process, which has led them to give AirPods a repairability score above zero for the first time.
Granted, the new AirPods 5 only scored 2 out of 10, but that’s still two points more than every previous generation combined.
iFixit notes that the left and right batteries are not interchangeable, as they use reversed polarity and slightly different contact placement.

That said, this is basically the long and short of AirPods 5 repairability. As iFixit shows in the video, going any further into the earbuds is still impossible without destroying them, and the same is true of their charging case.

iFixit’s teardown also includes its always-fascinating CT scans, which offer a detailed look at just how densely Apple has packed the batteries, MEMS microphones, H2 chip, and other tiny components inside each earbud.

evidence.raw_lead: Counterpoint 高级分析师林科宇称，600 万部更符合折叠屏手机这一小众市场的销量规模，与苹果其他 iPhone 的常规销量仍有明显差距。iPhone Duo 最终能卖出多少，很大程度上取决于苹果的产能爬坡速度。
evidence.title: Counterpoint：预计苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 今年将售出 600 万部

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，据彭博社今天（30 日）上午报道，Counterpoint Research 预计，苹果今年可售出约 600 万部 iPhone Duo。这也是外界首次对苹果首款折叠屏手机的销量作出预测。
Counterpoint 高级分析师林科宇称，600 万部更符合折叠屏手机这一小众市场的销量规模，与苹果其他 iPhone 的常规销量仍有明显差距。iPhone Duo 最终能卖出多少，很大程度上取决于苹果的产能爬坡速度。
新机售价 1,999 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 13,429 元人民币），国行定价 15999 元起，定于 10 月上市，是苹果产品线中定位最高的机型。业界也寄望于苹果带动更多消费者关注折叠屏手机，并进一步拉动市场销量。
IDC 预计，在苹果加入后，今年全球折叠屏手机出货量可增长 13% 至 2290 万部。如果没有 iPhone Duo，这一市场原本会陷入下滑。
Counterpoint 称，本月与 iPhone Duo 一同亮相的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在中国市场开局强劲。苹果此次首次只更新 Pro 系列，没有同步推出升级后的基础款，准备换机的消费者因此更多转向价格更高的 Pro 机型，使 iPhone 18 Pro 系列首销较 iPhone 17 Pro 系列增长 12%。
iPhone 18 Pro 系列的表现也帮助苹果在竞争激烈的中国智能手机市场取得 33% 的份额。报道提到，这种情况并不多见，华为、OPPO、vivo、小米和苹果通常各自占据大致相当的市场份额。零部件成本上涨也迫使各家手机厂商提价，希望用更高的单机收入弥补销量减少。对苹果而言，这反而缩小了竞争对手原有的价格优势。
林科宇指出，许多中国品牌旗舰机型涨价超过 200 美元（现汇率约合 1,344 元人民币），可能抬高了“价格锚点”，使 iPhone 在相对价值上的吸引力进一步增强。

evidence.title: 苹果iPhone 18 Pro系列又翻车！扬声器出现爆音异响

units.text: 快科技9月30日消息，苹果iPhone 18 Pro系列已经开售一段时间，除了眩光等设计缺陷之外，似乎还存在一些质量问题。
Reddit社区部分iPhone 18 Pro用户反馈，设备扬声器出现异常噼啪声。
用户描述该声音为噼啪声、轻微滴答声或随机咔哒声，多数反馈问题出在听筒扬声器，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max均受影响。
部分用户在使用应用、滚动网页、接收通知、键盘弹出或蜂窝通话时能听到异响。
开关飞行模式、快速调节屏幕亮度均可触发该声音。
甚至有用户退货后换了第二台iPhone，仍遇到相同问题。
苹果昨日发布iOS 27.0.1修复了Face ID认证失败导致iPhone 18 Pro重启的Bug，但更新日志未提及扬声器问题，早期反馈显示该更新并未解决此问题。
目前尚不清楚该问题的根本原因，如果属于软件Bug，后续更新可能修复；如果是硬件问题，可能需要走售后更换。

evidence.title: 部分苹果 iPhone 18 Pro/Max 用户反馈扬声器存在异响情况

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，科技媒体 MacRumors 今天（9 月 30 日）发布博文，报道称基于论坛、Reddit 社区用户反馈，苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 扬声器会出现噼啪声或爆音情况。
根据社区用户反馈，在使用 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 过程中，扬声器发出不寻常的噼啪声、轻微滴答声或爆裂声，亦有用户描述为随机咔嗒声。IT之家附上相关截图如下：
在影响场景上，部分用户反馈该异响持续存在，而部分用户反馈仅在使用应用、浏览网页、接收通知、键盘弹出或蜂窝通话时出现，此外还有部分用户反馈切换飞行模式、快速调节屏幕亮度也会触发该异响。
有用户反馈因为这个扬声器异响问题换机，不过换得的第二台 iPhone 仍存在同样异响。该媒体指出现阶段用户反馈较乱，也没有统一的复现路径，尚不清楚问题根源。

evidence.raw_lead: Long before the iPod, the Sony Walkman was the device of choice for those who wanted to add a soundtrack...
evidence.title: Duo-Man turns your 2026 iPhone Duo into a 1980s Sony Walkman - 9to5Mac

units.text: Long before the iPod, the Sony Walkman was the device of choice for those who wanted to add a soundtrack to their life. Now a Duo-Man app recreates the experience for those of us old enough to have owned one, and you’ll be able to use it with Apple Music …

Prior to the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the move, your options were limited. Most cassette players of the time were heavy and bulky. When Sony took an audio recorder designed for journalists and shrunk it into the smallest possible cassette player, it quickly became an iconic product.
Developer Vidit Bhargava created the app at a hackathon – and given that many of those present would never have seen one, he brought along the real thing to show them what it looked like.

Duo-Man offers the complete walkman experience on the iPhone Duo. Open the Duo to pick and 'insert' the cassette, Close the Duo to start listening. Yes, I actually recorded the button clicks and static noise from a real Walkman! It was fun making this at @bitrig hacks today. pic.twitter.com/juSrLhofrH
— Vidit Bhargava (@viditb) September 27, 2026
You open the Duo, choose your album to insert the tape, and then close it to play.

Bhargava said he originally only created it as a demo app for fun, but will now be releasing it as an actual app. The best comment in the X thread is this one, an image that will only make sense to people of a certain age.
What was your first ever music player? Please share in the comments.

evidence.discovery_title: Apple Creator Studio and Final Cut Camera Get New Features
evidence.raw_lead: Apple today updated Apple Creator Studio and Final Cut Camera for iOS to add new features. Final Cut Camera, Apple's professional iPhone filming app, now supports the variable aperture feature on the iPhone 18 Pro. Users can tweak aperture and select between aperture priority and shutter priority modes, plus there's support for Cinematic mode effects for video.
evidence.title: Apple Creator Studio and Final Cut Camera Get New Features

units.text: Apple Creator Studio and Final Cut Camera Get New Features
Apple today updated Apple Creator Studio and Final Cut Camera for iOS to add new features.

Final Cut Camera, Apple's professional iPhone filming app, now supports the variable aperture feature on the iPhone 18 Pro. Users can tweak aperture and select between aperture priority and shutter priority modes, plus there's support for Cinematic mode effects for video. Apple says the app was also redesigned from the ground up to give creators easy access to pro settings like shutter angle, ISO, and white balance.

There are customizable overlays with false color and clipping indicators for exposure and improved focus peaking with sensitivity control. A tally light activates when recording is happening, and there's a two-finger tap gesture for clearing the viewfinder to focus on the shot. Other new features include support for professional video scopes, clean SDI out, and genlock offset.

Pages, Numbers, and Keynote all have new templates and themes to choose from, along with better tools for collaboration. Keynote supports intelligent slide generation and Numbers has trigonometry, statistics, and logic functions for solving complex problems in a spreadsheet. Pages for Mac has a Screen View that optimizes content for reading and writing.

Pixelmator Pro for iPad has new template collections on Mac and ‌iPad‌ for launching ideas, businesses, or products. There's a Podcasts category with cover artwork options. The ‌iPad‌ app also adopts Select and Mask from the Mac app for precise mask and selection refinements.

Final Cut Pro and Motion on Mac have a new option to add Cinematic mode effects to video captured on the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌, so users can adjust focus points and depth of field in the Final Cut Pro timeline. Compressor supports converting video with Cinematic mode effects back into the previous Cinematic mode format, and it has new HEVC and MPEG–4 export presets.

Freeform includes automatic Dark Mode support for boards, folders for better organization, and support for Writing Tools. With Writing Tools, Apple Intelligence is able to rewrite, proofread, and summarize handwritten notes. In visionOS 27, the Vision Pro version of Freeform lets users pull multiple items from a board into their space, with multiple users able to view 3D models together as a group.

All of the updates are available today. Apple Creator Studio is priced at $12.99 per month and it gives access to all of Apple's creative apps like Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Pixelmator Pro. In free apps like Numbers, Pages, and Keynote, it adds premium features that are not available in the free apps.

evidence.raw_lead: 市场调查机构 CounterPoint Research 今天（9 月 30 日）发布博文，报道称相比较 iPhone 17 Pro 系列，苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在中国首周（第 38 周，统计口径为 3 天）同比增长 12%，推动苹果在 2026 年第 38 周登上中国智能手机周销量榜首，市场份额达到 33%。
evidence.title: CounterPoint 称 iPhone 18 Pro / Max 在中国首周销量同比增 12%，苹果 33% 份额跃居第 38 周销冠

units.text: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，市场调查机构 CounterPoint Research 今天（9 月 30 日）发布博文，报道称相比较 iPhone 17 Pro 系列，苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在中国首周（第 38 周，统计口径为 3 天）同比增长 12%，推动苹果在 2026 年第 38 周登上中国智能手机周销量榜首，市场份额达到 33%。
IT之家援引该媒体注释，2026 年第 38 周覆盖 9 月 14 日至 9 月 20 日，苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 系列仅贡献其中 3 天销量（18 日 ~20 日），苹果仍在该周跃居中国智能手机周销量榜首，市场份额达到 33%。
报告称，早期换机需求、渠道支持和竞品价格变化，共同影响 iPhone 18 Pro 的首销表现。iPhone 18 基础版延迟上市，也可能促使部分消费者转向 Pro 系列。
中国智能手机周销量自 7 月以来持续同比双位数下滑。Counterpoint Research 表示，消费者需求受到存储成本上涨影响，9 月新品集中发布后，市场环比表现出现复苏预期。

evidence.title: iPhone 18 Pro到手就卡顿 苹果：Spotlight在建索引 可能要几天

units.text: iPhone 18 Pro刚发售那几天，不少用户反馈新机器到手后有点卡，反应速度不如预期。这个问题之前被归因为iOS 27的Bug，现在苹果终于给出了官方解释——不是系统崩了，是Spotlight在后台建索引。
据AppleInsider报道，这种卡顿不只出现在iPhone 18 Pro系列上，老机型升级iOS 27后也有类似情况。根源都是同一个：系统在后台创建聚焦（Spotlight）索引。说白了就是系统在扫描手机里的文件、应用、照片、邮件、短信、联系人、音乐、备忘录，给它们建一个本地搜索目录，方便以后快速查找。
这个索引建完之后，好处其实挺多的。Spotlight搜文件、搜邮件、搜备忘录会更快，Siri AI也能基于这个索引从邮件和日历里提取信息，比如自动帮你查航班时间之类的。代价就是建索引的那阵子，CPU和硬盘都在高负载工作，用户就会觉得手机变慢、发热、耗电。
苹果在支持文档里明确说了，索引完全在设备本地执行，数据也都存在本地，不会上传到服务器。首次建索引的时候工作量最大，用户感知也最明显。具体要多久，取决于手机里存了多少东西——照片多、文件多、聊天记录多的用户，等的时间就更长。
苹果官方给出的时间范围是数小时甚至数天。但据实际观察，有些设备的索引过程甚至持续了一周左右。这个时间跨度确实有点长，难怪用户会以为手机出了问题。
苹果也给出了三个加速索引的方法：让设备处于闲置状态、接通电源、连上Wi-Fi或以太网。简单说就是晚上睡觉前把手机充上电，连着Wi-Fi放着，索引会建得快一些。
其实这个情况并不是iOS 27独有的。每次苹果推大版本更新，头几天都会有一波用户说手机变慢、耗电快，过几天就恢复正常了，背后大多是索引在作怪。只是今年iPhone 18 Pro同时还曝出了Face ID故障、自动重启等问题，让整个"首发翻车"的讨论显得更热闹了一些。
好消息是苹果已经推送了iOS 27.0.1更新，修复了Face ID故障等几个比较严重的Bug。建索引这个属于正常流程，不算Bug，等它建完了自然就好了。如果你的iPhone刚升级完或者刚到手觉得卡，不妨先耐心等几天，说不定过个周末就流畅了。

evidence.discovery_title: Apple Creator Studio lets you change iPhone 18 Pro video focus after filming
evidence.raw_lead: Apple Creator Studio's latest updates add selection tools to Pixelmator Pro for iPad, new editing options for iPhone 18 Pro video, and changes across its productivity apps.
evidence.title: Apple Creator Studio lets you change iPhone 18 Pro video focus after filming

units.text: Apple Creator Studio's latest updates add selection tools to Pixelmator Pro for iPad, new editing options for iPhone 18 Pro video, and changes across its productivity apps.
It's time to update Apple Creator Studio. The latest release touches nearly every app in the collection, from video and image editing to presentations and spreadsheets.

Pixelmator Pro for iPad now has Select and Mask controls for refining selections around difficult edges, such as hair and fur. On Mac and iPad, the app also gains sports, business, and podcast artwork templates.

Final Cut Pro and Motion on Mac can apply Cinematic mode effects to video captured natively on iPhone 18 Pro. In Final Cut Pro, editors can change focus points and depth of field directly in the timeline.
Compressor can convert footage with the new Cinematic mode effects to the previous Cinematic mode format. It also adds HEVC and MPEG-4 export presets designed for sharing projects on social media.
Subscribers also get new templates and themes in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. Keynote's Apple Intelligence-powered slide generation can now create images for a presentation.
All three iWork apps let users request access to shared files. Pages for Mac adds a reading and writing Screen View, and Numbers gains trigonometry, statistics, and logic functions.
Freeform boards now adapt to Dark Mode, while folders help organize boards and invite collaborators. Users can also request access to shared boards and add content through Shortcuts.
Apple Intelligence Writing Tools can rewrite, proofread, and summarize handwritten notes. In visionOS 27, users can pull board items into their space and view 3D models together.
Apple Creator Studio pricing options
Launched in January, Apple Creator Studio is a collection of creative and productivity apps. It lies somewhere between Adobe's Creative Cloud creative suite and Microsoft 365's productivity apps.
Apple Creator Studio costs $12.99 per month or $129 per year. New users can score a one-month free trial.
Education pricing drops it even lower, to $2.99 per month or $29.99 per year.

evidence.discovery_title: Hong Kong police want Apple's help in stopping $3.8M iPhone 18 Pro fraud
evidence.raw_lead: Since the iPhone 18 Pro went on sale, police in Hong Kong have dealt with over 1,500 cases of buyers using suspicious credit cards. They think Apple can stop it.
evidence.title: Hong Kong police want Apple's help in stopping $3.8M iPhone 18 Pro fraud

units.text: Since the iPhone 18 Pro went on sale, police in Hong Kong have dealt with over 1,500 cases of buyers using suspicious credit cards. They think Apple can stop it.

Hong Kong criminals have been involved in international theft before, and the Apple's progress in China at least initially faced bribery and fraud. Now according to local news site The Standard, fraudsters are targeting the iPhone 18 Pro by buying it in bulk using fake credit cards.

They're doing it to the tune of 1,503 reported suspicious charges on credit cards since the iPhone 18 Pro went on sale. The charges amounted to over $3.82 million, but the local police say that they have had all of these transactions canceled.

Significantly, Commissioner of Police Joe Chow Yat-ming told Kowloon City district council that in each case Apple's online security and verification were not in effect. Without explanation, he attributes the issue to what is being called a loophole in Apple's online store.

"This meant that one-time passwords or mobile app verification were not required," he told the South China Morning Post, "allowing fraudsters to place large orders using illegally obtained credit card information."
It's claimed that Apple's identity and payment verification requirements were somehow waived for web purchases. The fraudsters used VPNs and provided false or incomplete addresses.
Apple would subsequently email to ask for clarification over the delivery address, and the criminals would now specify a public location.

Chow also said that the police had asked Apple to review its transaction processes to prevent such fraud. He noted that the iPhone Duo is due to launch in October, suggesting he expects another rise in fraud attempts.
Apple has not commented publicly. They likely won't.

evidence.discovery_title: BofA America says Meta’s Muse highlights a new risk for Apple’s services revenue - 9to5Mac
evidence.raw_lead: Bank of America says Meta’s new Muse AI agent highlights how third-party AI agents could increasingly bypass Apple’s ecosystem and threaten its services revenue.
evidence.title: BofA America says Meta’s Muse highlights a new risk for Apple’s services revenue - 9to5Mac

units.text: In a new investor note issued today, Bank of America says Meta’s new Muse AI agent highlights how third-party AI agents could increasingly bypass Apple’s ecosystem and threaten its services revenue. Here are the details.
BofA maintains “Buy” rating

Apple’s shares dropped more than 2.5% today, after Bank of America’s Wamsi Mohan issued an investor note warning that AI agents such as Meta’s Muse could increasingly capture product discovery, referrals, and transactions that currently take place through Apple’s ecosystem.
From his note, via SeekingAlpha:
“The risk for Apple is that it can keep every handset sale and still lose discovery, referral, and transaction initiation.”

Mohan’s note comes as Meta’s Muse nears two weeks at No. 1 on the US App Store’s free apps chart. According to Sensor Tower estimates cited by TechCrunch, Muse has amassed more than 3.4 million downloads as of last week.

Meta’s OpenClaw-like AI agent can browse the web, fill out forms, book trips, send emails, and make purchases on a user’s behalf, and it seems to have caught on with the general public, as it took just 10 days to overtake ChatGPT at the top of the US App Store.

Back to Mohan’s note, he maintained a “Buy” rating and $370 price target on Apple, arguing that despite the new risks posed by AI agents, he still sees the company as an “eventual winner of AI at the edge.”
From his note, via Yahoo! Finance:
“Whomever the agent chooses becomes the merchant, and whoever owns the agent collects the routing economics that previously accrued to operating systems, search, and app stores.”

Mohan also points to Muse’s growing list of commerce integrations, including Shopify and Shop Pay, Expedia, and PayPal, as examples of how AI agents can increasingly handle transactions from discovery through checkout.
Additionally, Mohan notes that modern iPhones already have more than enough computing power to run AI agents, making software execution and integration the bigger challenge for Apple.

In his note, Mohan argues that Apple needs its Services, silicon, payments, privacy, and Siri AI teams to move together more quickly if the company wants to compete for what he calls the “economics of user intent.”
Specifically on Siri AI, he also noted that it lacks some of Muse’s capabilities, including persistent background tasks, broad third-party action support, and a dedicated agent payment rail.
He also pointed out the difference in development pace, with Apple typically shipping major software updates once a year, while AI agents can “improve daily.”
That said, Mohan sees Apple’s massive installed base and reputation for privacy as important advantages, particularly when it comes to convincing users to trust AI agents with sensitive tasks.
Have you been using AI agents such as Muse? let us know in the comments.
